Mishneh Torah, Robbery and Lost Property:
Kol hammotze aveda ben sheyyesh bah siman ben shiin bah siman im metzaah derech hannacha asur ligga bah shemma bealeha hinnichuha sham ad sheyyachzeru lah veim yavo littelenna vehaya davar sheen bo siman hare ibbed mamon chavero beyado shehare en lo bah siman lehachezir bo. veim haya davar sheyyesh lo siman hare ze hitrichan lirdof achareha velatet simaneha. ulefichach asur lo sheyyigga bah ad sheyyimtzaenna derech nefila. vaafillu nistappek lo haddavar velo yada im davar ze avud o munnach hare ze lo yigga bo. veim avar unetalo asur lo lehacheziro lesham. veim haya davar sheen bo siman zacha bo veeno chayyav lehacheziro: 
Vechol davar sheyyesh bo siman ben bederech hannacha ben bederech nefila ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim chayyav lehacheriz. ketzad. derech hannacha kegon shemmatza chamor o para roim badderech bayyom o shemmatza keli mechusse baashpa hare ze lo yigga bahen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 1)</small> "niddachim badderech". aval im matza chamor vechelav hafuchim ufara ratza ben hakkeramim o keli megulle baashpa hare zo aveda venotel umachriz: 
Raa chamor o para roim baafar kedarkan ballayla hare zo aveda. bifnot hayyom uvanneshef im raa otan shelosha yamim ze achar ze hare zo aveda venotel umachriz. raa para ratza badderech im paneha kelappe hair en zo aveda. kelappe hassade hare zo aveda: 
Metzaah roa ben hakkeramim chayyav lehachezir mishshum avedat hakkarka. lefichach im hayu hakkeramim shel akkum enah aveda veeno chayyav lehachezir. veim chashash shemma yahargenna haakkum kesheyyimtzaenna mippene shehifsida hakkerem hare zo aveda venotel umachriz: 
Matza para birshut harabbim im omedet chutz lattechum chayyav lehachezir. hayta roa baasavim o shehayta berefet sheenah mishtammeret veenah meabbedet lo yigga bah sheen zo aveda. matza tallit o kardom betzad haggader hare ze lo yigga bahen. bisratya hare ze notel umachriz. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Matza gozalot mekushsharin bechanfehen umedaddin achar haggader o achar haggappa o bashshevilin shebbassadot hare ze lo yigga bahen shemma baalehen hinnichum sham. veim netalan hare ellu shello. veim hayu keshurin kesher shehu siman chayyav lehacheriz. vechen im metzaan kevuim bimkoman chayyav lehacheriz shehammakom siman: 
Matza baashpa keli mechusse hare ze lo yigga bo kemo shebbearnu. veim ashpa sheenah asuya lehitpannot hi venimlach aleha lefannotah af al pi shemmetzao mechusse notel umachriz. vechen im hayu kelim ketannim kegon sakkin veshippud vechayyotze bahen afillu hayu mechussin baashpa hakkevua notel umachriz: 
Matza perot mefuzzarin derech hannacha lo yigga bahen. derech nefila hare hen shello. vechen im matza kerichot ketannot shel shibbolim birshut harabbim shehare en bahen siman. o shemmatza iggule devela vechikkarot shel nachtom umachrozot shel dagim vachatichot shel basar vegizze tzemer habbaot mimmedinatan vaanitze pishtan uleshonot shel argaman hare ellu shello mippene sheen bahen siman. veim yesh bahen siman notel umachriz shessiman heasuy liddares hare hu siman: 
Aval im matza kikkarot shel baal habbayit vegizze tzemer hallekuchot mibbet haumman kadde yayin vechadde shemen chayyav lehacheriz shekkol ellu yesh lahem simanin muvhakin. veim niftechu haotzarot shel yayin veshel shemen hare ellu shello. veaf al pi shehem reshumin. shekkol hakkaddot kach hayu reshumot venimtzeu ellu hakkaddin kechikkerot hannachtom sheyyesh tzura achat lechullan umishkal echad lechullam: 
Matza kerichot birshut hayyachid im derech nefila hare ellu shello. veim derech hannacha chayyav lehacheriz sheaf al pi sheen lahem siman hammakom siman (af al pi sheeno siman muvhak). matza alummot ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim notel umachriz: 
Matza iggul uvetocho cheres. kikkar uvetocho maot. chaticha shel basar shehu meshunne bachatichot. dag nashuch. vechen kol kayyotze beellu hoil veyesh bahen shinnuy chayyav lehacheriz. shello asaum baalehen ella lesiman: 
Matza perot mefuzzarin bemakom haggoranot im hayu kemo kav betoch arba ammot o beyeter al arba ammot hare ellu shello mippene sheen habbealim metappelim baasifatan. hayu mefuzzarin befachot mearba ammot lo yigga bahen shemma habbealim hinnichum sham. hayu kemo chatzi kav bishte ammot o kabbayim bishmone ammot o shehaya hakkav mishshenayim ushelosha minin kemo temarim shumshemin [verimmonim] kol ellu safek lefichach lo yittol. veim natal eno chayyav lehacheriz: 
Hammotze tzibbure perot o perot bichli o keli kemot shehu chayyav lehacheriz. matza keli ulefanav perot hare ellu shello happerot. vehakkeli notel umachriz. sheani omer hakkeli shel echad vehapperot shel acher vahare en bo siman. veim marin haddevarim shehen shel adam echad chayyav lehacheriz: 
Ketzad. hayu achore hakkeli lifne happerot hare ellu shello. hayu pene hakkeli lifne happerot choshshin shemma min hakkeli nishpechu. veim hayu oggonim lakkeli af al pi sheppanav kelappe happerot hare ellu shello sheillu nishpechu min hakkeli haya nishar mehen betocho mippene haoggonim. hayu miktzat happerot bakkeli umiktzatan baaretz chayyav lehacheriz: 
Hammotze ketziot badderech vaafillu betzad sede ketziot hare ellu shello. vechen teena shehi nota ladderech venimtzeu teenim tachteha muttarot mishshum gezel. shehatteena vechayyotze bah im nefilatah nimeset. ufeturot mishshum maaser. aval zetim vecharuvin vechayyotze bahen asurin: 
Temarim shemmeshiran haruach muttarot shehabbealim mechalum lechol adam vezo hi chezkatan. veim hayu shel yetomim sheenan bene mechila asurin. vechen im hikpid baal hassade vehikkif mekom hailanot o tikken makom sheyyippelu bo hannovlot ad sheyyelakketem hare ellu asurot shehare gilla dato shello machal: 
Chatul ra shehoreg et hakketannim asur lekayyemo veen bo mishshum gezel veen bo mishshum heshshev aveda af al pi sheoro moil ella kol hammotzo zacha bo vehorgo vehaor shello: 
Gozal hannimtza karov lashshovach betoch chamishshim amma hare hu shel baal hashshovach chutz lachamishshim amma hare hu shel motzo sheen haggozal medadde yeter al chamishshim amma. nimtza ben shene shovachot hare hu shel karov. mechetza lemechetza yachaloku. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu yone shete hashshovachot shavim beminyan. aval im hayu yone haechad rabbim hallech achar harov af al pi shehu rachok:

Hammotze mechatim vetzinnorot umasmerim vechayyotzo bahen im metzaam echad echad hare ellu shello. shenayim shenayim o yeter chayyav lehacheriz shemminyan siman: 
Vechen hammotze maot mefuzzarim hare ellu shello. afillu hayu miktzat matbeot ze al gabbe ze hare hen kimfuzzarin. aval im matza tzibbur maot chayyav lehacheriz. matza shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze vehen asuyin kemigdal. o shehayu echad mikkan veechad mikkan veechad al gabbehen. o shehayu miktzat ze al miktzat ze kede sheim yachnis kesam benehen yinnatlu bevat achat chayyav lehacheriz. hayu asuyim keshir o keshura o kachatzuva o kesullam hare ze safek velo yittol: 
Hammotze maot bakkis o kis kemot shehu chayyav lehacheriz. matza kis ulefanav maot mefuzzarim hare ellu shello. veim marin haddevarim shehakkis vehammaot shel adam echad umin hakkis naflu chayyav lehacheriz: 
Hammotze maot bachanut im hayu ben teva lachenvani hare hen shel baal hachanut. veim metzaan al hatteva veen tzarich lomar mitteva velachutz hare hen shel motzan. velamma lo tikne hachanut livaleha lefi sheenah chatzer hammishtammeret. veaf al pi shebbealeha betochah tzarich lomar tikne li chanuti kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Matza maot bachanut hashshulchani ben kisse lashshulchani hare ellu shel shulchani. metzaan al hakkisse lifne hashshulchani afillu hayu tzerurin umunnachin al hashshulchan hare ellu shel motzan. vehu sheyyihyu rov akkum kemo shebbearnu. aval im hayu rov yisrael chayyav lehacheriz. mippene shehen tzerurim yesh lahem siman: 
Hallokeach perot mechavero o sheshshalach lo chavero perot umatza betochan maot tzerurot notel umachriz. metzaan mefuzzarot hare ellu shello. bamme devarim amurim beshehayu happerot min hattaggar o mibbaal habbayit shellekachan min hattaggar. aval im baal habbayit dash happerot leatzmo o al yede avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim hare ze chayyav lehachezir: 
Hammotze matmon begal o bechotel yashan hare ellu shello sheani omer shel emoriyyim hakkadmonim hen. vehu sheyyimtzaem matta matta kederech kol hammatmonot hayeshanot. aval im marin haddevarim shehen matmon chadash afillu nistappek lo haddavar hare ze lo yigga bahen shemma munnachim hem sham: 
Vehoil vachatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato kemo sheyyitbaer lamma lo yikne baal hechatzer ze hammatmon shebbetoch hakkotel hayyashan af al pi shehu shel emoriyyim vetihye metzia zo levaal hechatzer. mippene sheeno yadua lo velo laacherim vahare ze hammatmon avud mimmennu umikkol adam ulefichach hu shel motzo. uma aveda shel adam amra tora <small>(Devarim 22 3)</small> "asher tovad mimmennu umetzatah" mi sheavuda mimmennu umetzuya etzel kol adam yatzat zo shennafla layyam sheavuda mimmennu umikkol adam kal vachomer lematmon kadmoni shello haya shello meolam vehu avud mimmennu umikkol adam lefichach hu shel motzo: 
Matza matmon bechotel chadash im hammatmon mochiach shehu levaal habbayit hare hu shello veim mochiach shehu shel acher min hashshuk hare hu shel motzo. ketzad. hassakkin hare hannitztzav shello mochiach. vehakkis piv mochiach. veim nimtza toch hakkotel male mehen cholkin: 
Hayu betoch hakkotel maot o leshonot shel zahav sheen sham mochiach. mechetzyo velachutz shel motze. mechetzyo ulefanim shel baal habbayit: 
Veyerae li sheen haddevarim amurim ella keshettaan baal habbayit shehammatmon shello. o shehaya yoresh sheanu toanin lo shemma shel aviv hen. aval im hoda shehen metzia hare hen shel motze. lefichach im haya maskir beto laacherim hare hen shel socher acharon. veim hiskiro lishlosha akkum keechad hare asaahu pundak vechol hannimtza bo afillu betoch habbayit hare hu shel motzan mippene sheen echad yachol liton shehen shello o shehu taman shehare asaahu pundak:

Kol metzia sheamarnu bah shehi shel motzah eno zoche bah ad shettaggia leyado o lirshuto. aval im raa et hammetzia afillu nafal aleha uva acher vehechezik bah hare ze shehechzik bah zacha bah: 
Haya rochev al gabbe behema veraa et hammetzia veamar lachavero zeche li bah kevan shehigbihah lo kana harochev veaf al pi shello higgia leyado. veim amar lo tena li unetalah veamar ani zachiti bah zacha bah hannotel. veim mishshennetanah larochev amar ani zachiti bah techilla lo amar kelum: 
Hammagbiah metzia lachavero kana chavero veaf al pi shello amar lo kelum [zacha bah]. higbihu hammetzia shenayim kenauha shenehem: 
Higbihah lo cheresh o shote o katan lo kana happikkeach lefi sheen lahen daat. higbihah cheresh ufikkeach keechad mittoch shello kana pikkeach lo kana cheresh. hayu shenehem chershim tikkenu chachamim sheyyiknu kede shello yavou lehinnatzot: 
Shenayim sherau gamal o chamor shel metzia vekadmu shenehem vehinhiguhu o meshachuhu. o shehaya echad manhig veechad moshech. kanu shenehem. bamme devarim amurim bachamor aval begamal im haya echad manhig veechad moshech hammoshech kana aval lo hammanhig: 
Behemat metzia shekkadam echad veachaz bammosera lo kana ad sheyyimshoch o yanhig. vechen benichse hagger. aval kana hammosera levaddah: 
Haya echad rochev veechad ochez bammosera harochev kana habbehema vehammosera sheal lechaye habbehema bilvad. veze sheachaz hammosera kana mimmenna ma sheachaz beyado. ushear hammosera lo kanahu echad mehen: 
Chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato. veim nafla bah metzia hare hi shel baal hechatzer. bamme devarim amurim bechatzer hammishtammeret. aval besade veginna vechayyotze bahen im haya omed betzad sadehu veamar zachta li sadi zacha bah. veim eno omed sham o shehaya omed velo amar zachta li sadi kol hakkodem zacha. vechen arba ammot shel adam shehu omed betziddan hare ellu konim lo. veim higgia hammetzia letoch arba ammot shello zacha bah: 
Chachamim tikkenu davar ze kede shello yarivu hammotzin ze im ze. bamme devarim amurim besimta o betzidde reshut harabbim sheen harabbim dochakin bahen o besade sheen lo bealim. aval haomed birshut harabbim o betoch sede chavero en arba ammot konot lo veeno kone sham ad shettaggia metzia leyado: 
Ketanna yesh lah chatzer veyesh lah arba ammot. vekatan en lo chatzer veen lo arba ammot. mippene shechatzer shel ketanna miyyadah lemadnuha. shekkeshem shehi mitgareshet beget hammaggia leyadah kach mitgareshet beget hammaggia lachatzerah. ucheshem sheyyesh lah chatzer leinyan hagget kach yesh lah leinyan metzia. vearba ammot shel adam kachatzero leinyan metzia. aval haish lamadnu shechatzero kona lo mishshelucho. kederech shekkone lo shelucho kach tikne lo chatzero. vehakkatan hoil veeno ose shaliach kach en chatzero velo arba ammot shello konin lo ad shettaggia metzia leyado: 
Mi sheraa acherim ratzim achar hammetzia vahare hi tzevi shavur o gozalot shello parchu. im haya omed betzad sadehu shehen betochah veillu haya ratz haya maggian veamar zachta li sadi zachta lo sadehu. veim eno yachol lehaggian hare ellu kitzvi shehu ratz kedarko uchegozalot hammafrichim velo amar kelum ella kol hakkodem bahen zacha. veim nittenu lo bemattana hoil veacher hiknam lo vahare hen mitgalgelin betoch sadehu kanta lo sadehu veim haya tzevi ratz kedarko vegozalot mafrichin lo kanta lo sadehu: 
Metziat cheresh shote vekatan yesh bah gezel mippene darche shalom. lefichach im avar acher ugezalah miyyadan enah yotza bedayyanim. veim kafar bah venishba eno chayyav bechomesh: 
Metziat beno uvitto hassemuchim al shulchano af al pi shehen gedolim umetziat bitto hannaara af al pi sheenah somechet al shulchano vaafillu hayta mechura amma umetziat avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim umetziat ishto hare ellu shello. aval metziat beno sheeno somech al shulchano af al pi shehu katan umetziat avdo veshifchato haivrim umetziat ishto shehi megoreshet veenah megoreshet kol ellu hammetziot enan shello:

Hammotze shetar chov af al pi shello peresh bo acharayut nechasim veaf al pi shehachayyav mode veaf al pi shehu mekuyyam hare ze lo yachzir. shemma perao ukenuneya hem osim kede litrof lakochot shello kaddin ulefichach hoda lo shehare yesh lo litrof bishtar shello peresh bo acharayut. shehaacharayut shello nitparsha taut sofer hu ben beshitre halevaa ben beshitre mikkach umimkar. lefichach im peresh bishtar ze shehu shello beacharayut im haya hachayyav mode yachzir veim lav lo yachzir shemma perao:
Vechen im matza shetar shezzemanno bo bayyom vehaya mekuyyam vehachayyav mode yachzir. veim eno mekuyyam lo yachzir shemma katav lilvot vaadayin lo lava:

Matza shetar bechemet o bichli etz vechayyotze bahen hare ze yachzir lemi shennatan siman. matza shelosha shetarot keruchin becherech echad o munnachin ze al ze vaagudim eged echad yachzir lemi shennatan siman:

Haya hallo echad vehammalvim shelosha im mekuyyamim hem yachzir lallo. veim lav yachzir lemi shennatan siman shemma hammalvim natnu shetarotehen lassofer lekayyeman venaflu miyyad haddayyan. haya hammalve echad vehallovim shelosha yachzir lammalve. veim hayu shelashtan bichtav yede sofer echad yachzir lemi shennatan siman. shemma shelashtan holichu shitrehen lassofer lichtov venaflu miyyad hassofer:

Matza shetarot keruin ushetar chov benehen lo yachzir. veim yesh immahen shover afillu belo edim yitten shetar hachov lallo. sheillu lo haya parua lo hishlicho ben shetarot keruim vahare yesh immo ketav shehu parua:

Matza gitte nashim bizman shehabbaal mode yachzir laishsha. en habbaal mode im natna haishsha siman muvhak yinnaten lah veim lav lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. amar habbaal miyyadi nafal venatan simanav vehaishsha omeret miyyadi nafal venatna simanav yinnaten lah. vehu shettitten siman muvhak kegon sheamra nekev yesh betzad ot pelonit. sheillu lo higgia leyadah lo hayta yodaat:

Hu omer simane hachut shekkashar bo hagget vehi omeret simane hachut yinnaten lah. vehu shettomar siman muvhak kegon orech middat hachut. aval im amra adom o shachor hu en ze siman muvhak. hu omer bechemet haya munnach vehi omeret bechemet haya munnach yinnaten lo sheen ze siman muvhak:
Matza get shichrur bizman sheharav mode yachzir laeved. en harav mode lo yachzir lo laze velo laze:

Matza shetar mattana im mattenat bari hi af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. shemma katav litten velo natan veachar shekkatav shetar ze machar sade zo o netanah leacher bemattana vechazar bo. veze shemmode laze kede laasot kenuneya al haacharon shennatan lo o shemmachar lo. veim mattenat shechiv mera hi im hoda yitten veim lav lo yitten. sheshshechiv mera shennatan lishnayim ze achar ze haacharon kana kemo sheyyitbaer:

Met shechiv mera shennetanah bemattana af al pi shehayyoresh mode shemmorisho netanah hare ze lo yachzir lo laze velo laze. shemma katav litten velo natan umecharah hayyoresh o netanah vechazar bo vahare hu rotze laasot kenuneya im ze kede lehafekia nichse ze haacharon:
Matza shover bizman shebbaal hashshetar mode shennishbar shetaro uferao o mechalo yitten levaal hashshover. en shenehem modim lo yachzir lo laze velo laze:
Matza ketubba af al pi sheshshenehem modim lo yachzir laishsha shemma nifrea ketubba zo o nimchala veachar kach machar habbaal nechasav vahare hu rotze laasot kenuneya al hallakochot:

Matza iggerot shum veiggerot mazon shitre chalitza umeunin veshitre teanot shekkotvin haddayyanin shel baal din ze veshel chavero. o shemmatza shitre berurim vehem hashshetarot shebberru lahen baale dinin et haddayyanin sheddanin lahem vekibbelu alehem sheyyadunu lahem peloni ufeloni. o shemmatza kol maase bet din. hare ze yachzir. kelalo shel davar kol shetar shechoshshin bo leferaon lo yachzir shemma nifra hachov. veim haya hachayyav mode veefshar shehoda kede laasot kenuneya ad sheyyafsid et hallokeach o mekabbel mattana shellekacho achar zeman hashshetar kede sheyyifreu miyyadam shello kaddin hare ze lo yachzir af al pi sheshshenehem modim. vechol shetar sheen bo tzad lachashash lo leferaon velo liknuneya yachzir livalav:

Kol hashshetarot hannimtzaim sheddinan shello yachzir im hechzir hare ellu kesherim vegovin bahen veen motziin otan mittachat yad baalehen vahare hem bechezkatan veen choshshin lahem: seliku lehu hilchot gezela vaaveda besad
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 1:
Shevita bashshevii mimmelacha mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 21)</small> "uvayyom hashshevii tishbot". vechol haose bo melacha bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 5 14)</small> "lo taase chol melacha". uma hu chayyav al asiyyat melacha. im asa birtzono bezadon chayyav karet. veim hayu sham edim vehateraa niskal. veim asa bishgaga chayyav karban chattat kevua: 
Kol makom shenneemar behilchot shabbat shehaose davar ze chayyav hare ze chayyav karet. veim hayu sham edim vehateraa chayyav sekila. veim haya shogeg chayyav chattat: 
Vechol makom shenneemar shehaose davar ze patur hare ze patur min hakkaret umin hassekila umin hakkarban aval asur laasot oto davar beshabbat veissuro middivre sofrim vehu harechaka min hammelacha. vehaose oto bezadon makkin oto makkat mardut. vechen kol makom shenneemar en osin kach vechach o asur laasot kach vechach beshabbat haose oto davar bezadon makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Vechol makom shenneemar muttar laasot kach vechach hare ze muttar lechattechilla. vechen kol makom shenneemar eno chayyav kelum o patur mikkelum en makkin oto kelal: 
Devarim hammuttarim laasotan beshabbat uvishat asiyyatan efshar shettease biglalan melacha veefshar shello tease. im lo nitkavven leotah melacha hare ze muttar. ketzad. gorer adam mitta vechisse vesafsal vechayyotze bahen beshabbat uvilvad shello yitkavven lachpor charitz bakkarka bishat geriratan. ulefichach im chafru hakkarka eno choshesh bechach lefi shello nitkavven. vechen mehallech adam al gabbe asavim beshabbat uvilvad shello yitkavven laakor otan. lefichach im neekru eno choshesh. verochetz yadav baafar happerot vechayyotze bo uvilvad shello yitkavven lehashshir hassear. lefichach im nashar eno choshesh. vechen pirtza dechuka muttar lehikkanes bah beshabbat af al pi shemmashshir tzerorot. vechen kol davar sheen mitkavven kegon ze hare ze muttar: 
Aval asa maase venaaset biglalo melacha shevvadday tease bishvil oto maase af al pi shello nitkavven lah chayyav. shehaddavar yadua shei efshar shello tease otah melacha. ketzad. hare shetztzarich lerosh of letzachek bo hakkatan vechatach rosho beshabbat af al pi sheen sof megammato laharigat haof bilvad chayyav shehaddavar yadua shei efshar sheyyachtoch rosh hachay veyichye ella hammavet ba bishvilo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Kol haose melacha beshabbat af al pi sheeno tzarich legufah shel melacha chayyav aleha. ketzad. hare shekkibba et hanner mippene shehu tzarich lashshemen o lappetila kede shello yovad o kede shello yissaref o kede shello yibbaka cheres shel ner. mippene shehakkibbuy melacha vahare nitkavven lechabbot veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leguf hakkibbuy velo kibba ella mippene hashshemen o mippene hacheres o mippene happetila hare ze chayyav. vechen hammaavir et hakkotz arba ammot birshut harabbim o hamechabbe et haggachelet kede shello yizzoku bahen rabbim chayyav veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leguf hakkibbuy o leguf hahaavara ella leharechik hahezzek hare ze chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Kol hammitkavven laasot melacha venaasa lo melacha acheret shello nitkavven lah patur aleha lefi shello naaset machashavto. ketzad. zarak even o chetz bachavero o bivhema kede lehargan vehalach veakar ilan bahalichato velo harag hare ze patur. hare ze kal vachomer im nitkavven leissur kal venaasa issur chamur. kegon shennitkavven lizrok becharmelit veavra haeven lirshut harabbim shehu patur. vechen kol kayyotze baze. nitkavven laasot davar hammuttar veasa davar acher kegon shennitkavven lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar eno chayyav kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Nitkavven lilkot teenim shechorot velikket levanot o shennitkavven lilkot teenim veachar kach anavim venehpach haddavar velikket haanavim battechilla veachar kach teenim patur af al pi shellikket kol ma shechashav hoil velo likket kasseder shechashav patur shebbelo kavvana asa shello asra tora ella melechet machshevet: 
Hayu lefanav shete nerot dolkot o kevuyot nitkavven lechabbot zo vechibba et zo lehadelik zo vehidlik et zo chayyav shehare asa min hammelacha shechashav laasotah. ha lema hu dome lemi shennitkavven lilkot teena zo velikket teena acheret. o lemi shennitkavven laharog et ze veharag et ze shehare naaset melacha shechashav laasotah: 
Aval im nitkavven lehadelik rishona ulechabbot sheniyya achareha venehpach haddavar vechibba rishona veachar kach hidlik sheniyya achareha patur. kibba zo vehidlik zo binshima achat chayyav. sheaf al pi shello hikdim hahadlaka hare ze lo icher otah ella shetehen keachat ulefichach chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechol haose melacha bemitassek velo nitkavven lah patur: 
Kol hammitkavven laasot melacha venaaset beyoter al kavvanato chayyav. befachot mikkavvanato patur. ketzad. hare shennitkavven lehotzi massa leacharav uva lo lefanav chayyav shehare nitkavven lishmira pechuta venaaset shemira meulla. aval im nitkavven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav patur shehare nitkavven lehotzi bishmira meulla vehotzi bishmira pechuta. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haya chagur besinnar vehishlich hammassa ben besaro vachaluko ben shebba ze hammassa sheddarko lehotzio badderech hazzot lefanav ben shebba leacharav chayyav shekken darko lihyot chozer: 
Kol hamitkavven laasot melacha beshabbat vehitchil bah veasa kashshiur chayyav. af al pi shello hishlim kol hammelacha shennitkavven lehashelimah. ketzad. hare shennitkavven lichtov iggeret o shetar beshabbat en omrim lo yitchayyev ze ad sheyyashlim cheftzo veyichtov kol hashshetar o kol haiggeret ella mishsheyyichtov shete otiyyot chayyav. vechen im nitkavven leerog beged shalem mishsheyeerog shene chutin chayyav veaf al pi shekkavvanato lehashelim habbeged hoil veasa kashshiur bechavvana chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Kol melacha shehayyachid yachol laasot otah levaddo veasu otah shenayim beshuttafut ben sheasa ze miktzatah veze miktzatah kegon sheakar ze hachefetz mershut zo vehinnicho hashsheni birshut acheret ben sheasu otah shenehem keechad mittechilla vead sof kegon sheachazu shenehem bekulmos vechatvu o achazu kikkar vehotziuhu mershut lirshut hare ellu peturin: 
Veim en echad mehen yachol laasotah levaddo ad sheyyitztarfu kegon shenayim sheachazu kora vehotziuha lirshut harabbim hoil veen koach beechad mehen laasotah levaddo veasu otah beshuttafut mittechilla vead sof shenehen chayyavin veshiur echad lishnehen. haya koach beechad lehotzi kora zo levaddo vehashsheni eno yachol lehotziah levaddo venishtattefu shenehem vehotziuha. ze harishon sheyyachol chayyav vehashsheni mesayyea hu umesayyea eno chayyav kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Kol hamekalkelin peturin. ketzad. hare shechaval bachavero o bivhema derech hashechata vechen im kara begadim o serafan o shavar kelim derech hashechata hare ze patur. chafar guma veeno tzarich ella laafarah hare ze mekalkel ufatur. af al pi sheasa melacha hoil vechavvanato lekalkel patur: 
Kol hamekalkel al menat letakken chayyav. ketzad. hare shessatar kede livnot bimkomo o shemmachak kede lichtov bammakom shemmachak o shechafar guma kede livnot betochah yesodot vechol kayyotze baze chayyav. veshiuran keshiur hametakken: 
Kol haose melacha beshabbat miktzatah beshogeg umiktzatah bezadon ben shehezid ulevassof shagag ben sheshshagag ulevassof hezid patur ad sheyyaase shiur hammelacha kullah mittechilla vead sof bezadon veachar kach yihye chayyav karet. veim yihye beedim vehateraa chayyav sekila. o sheyyaase shiur melacha kullah bishgaga mittechilla vead sof veachar kach yihye chayyav chattat kevua:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 2: Dechuya hi shabbat etzel sakkanat nefashot kishar kol hammitzvot. lefichach chole sheyyesh bo sakkana osin lo kol tzerachav beshabbat al pi rofe umman shel oto makom. safek shehu tzarich lechallel alav et hashshabbat safek sheeno tzarich. vechen im amar rofe lechallel alav et hashshabbat verofe acher omer eno tzarich mechallelin alav et hashshabbat shessefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat:

Amaduhu beyom hashshabbat shehu tzarich lechach vechach lishmona yamim en omrim namtin ad haerev kede shello lechallel alav shete shabbatot ella matchilin mehayyom shehu shabbat umechallelin alav afillu mea shabbatot kol zeman shehu tzarich veyesh bo sakkana o sefek sakkana mechallelin. umadlikin lo et hanner umechabbin millefanav et hanner veshochatin lo veofin umevashshelin umechimmin lo chammin ben lehashekoto ben lirchitzat gufo. kelalo shel davar shabbat legabbe chole sheyyesh bo sakkana hare hu kechol lechol haddevarim shehu tzarich lahen:

Kesheosim devarim haellu en osin otan lo al yede nachrim velo al yede ketannim velo al yede avadim velo al yede nashim kede shello tehe shabbat kalla beenehem. ella al yede gedole yisrael vechachmehem. veasur lehitmahmeah bechillul shabbat lechole sheyyesh bo sakkana shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 5)</small> "asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem" velo sheyyamut bahem. ha lamadta sheen mishpete hattora nekama baolam ella rachamim vechesed veshalom baolam. veillu haeppikorosim sheomrim shezze chillul shabbat veasur alehen hakkatuv omer <small>(Yechezkel 20 25)</small> "gam ani natatti lahem chukkim lo tovim umishpatim lo yichyu bahem":

Hachoshesh beenav vehu sheyyihye bishtehem o beachat mehem tzir o shehayu demaot shottot mehen merov hakkeev o shehaya dam shotet mehen o shehaya bahen kaddachat vechayyotze bocholaim ellu hare ze bichlal cholim sheyyesh bahen sakkana umechallelin alav et hashshabbat veosin lo kol tzarche refua:

Vechen im yesh makka bachalal gufo min hassafa ulefanim ben befiv ben bemeav ben bichvedo utecholo o bishar mekomot kol sheyyesh bachalalo hare ze chole sheyyesh bo sakkana veeno tzarich omed shechalyo kaved hu lefichach mechallelin alav et hashshabbat miyyad belo amida. umakka shehi begav hayyad vegav haregel hare hi kemakka shel chalal veenah tzericha omed umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. vehachom shemmesammer et habbasar kemakka shel chalal dami umechallelin alav et hashshabbat vechen kol choli sheharofim omrin shezze yesh bo sakkana af al pi shehu beor habbasar mibbachutz mechallelin alav et hashshabbat al pihem:

Habbolea nima shel mayim mechimmin lo chammin beshabbat veosin lo kol tzarche refua mippene shehi sakkanat nefashot. vechen mi shenneshacho kelev shote o echad mizzochale heafar shemmemitin afillu hayu safek memitin safek en memitin osin lo kol tzarche refua lehatztzilo:

Chole sheamaduhu rofim lehavi lo gerogeret achat veratzu asara bene adam veheviu lo eser gerogarot bevat achat kullan peturin mikkelum. vaafillu heviu baze achar ze vaafillu hivri barishona shehare kullam birshut heviu:

Chole shehaya tzarich lishte gerogarot velo matzu ella shete gerogarot bishne ektzin veshalosh gerogarot beoketz echad kortin haoketz sheyyesh bo shalosh af al pi sheen tzerichin ella lishtayim kede shello yarbu bivtzira ella yichretu oketz echad velo yichretu shenayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hamevashshel lechole beshabbat veachal hachole vehotir asur levari leechol min hammuttar gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo. aval hashshochet lachole beshabbat muttar labbari leechol mimmennu basar chay sheen baddavar tosefet kede shennigzor shemma yarbe bishvilo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Chole sheen bo sakkana osin lo kol tzerachav al yede nachri. ketzad. omrin lannachri laasot lo vehu ose. levashshel lo veleefot ulehavi refua mershut lirshut vechayyotze baellu. vechen kochel enav min hannachri beshabbat af al pi sheen sham sakkana. veim hayu tzerichim lidvarim sheen bahen melacha osin otan afillu yisrael. lefichach maalin aznayim beshabbat umaalin unkeli umachzirin et hashshever vechol kayyotze baze muttar:

Hayyoledet keshekkoraat leled hare hi besakkanat nefashot umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. korin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom vechotchim et hattabbur vekoshrin oto. veim hayta tzericha lener beshaa shehi tzoeket bachavaleha madlikin lah et hanner. vaafillu hayta suma mippene sheddatah mityashshevet aleha banner veaf al pi sheenah roa. veim hayta tzericha leshemen vechayyotze bo meviin lah. vechol sheefshar leshannot meshannin bishat havaa kegon shettavi lah chavertah keli taluy bisarah. veim i efshar mevia kedarkah:

En meyalledin et haovedet kochavim umazzalot beshabbat vaafillu besachar veen choshshin leeva veaf al pi sheen sham chillul. aval meyalledin et bat ger toshav mippene sheanu metzuvvin lehachayoto. veen mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat:

Chayya mishsheyyatchil haddam lihyot shotet ad shetteled veachar shetteled ad shelosha yamim mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat veosin lah kol tzeracheha. ben sheamra tzericha ani ben sheamra eni tzericha. umishshelosha ad shiva im amra eni tzericha en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. veim shatka veen tzarich lomar im amra tzericha ani shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. umishshiva vead sheloshim yom hare hi kechola sheen bo sakkana vaafillu amra tzericha ani en osin lah melacha ella al yede nachrim:

Osin medura lechayya vaafillu bimot hachamma mippene shehatztzinna kasha lechayya harebe bammekomot hakkarim. aval en osin medura lechole lehitchammem bah. hikkiz dam venitztannen osin lo medura afillu bitkufat tammuz. umarchitzin et havvalad beshabbat bayyom shennolad achar shechotchin et tibburo afillu bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat. umolchin oto umelappefin oto mippene shessakkana hi lo im lo yaasu lo kol ellu. vechen marchitzim oto lifne hammila uleachar hammila uvayyom hashshelishi lammila bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat mippene hassakkana:

Haishsha sheyyashva al hammashber umeta meviin sakkin beshabbat afillu derech reshut harabbim vekorin et keresah umotziin et havvalad shemma yimmatze chay shessefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat vaafillu laze sheen chezkato chay:

Mefakkechin pikkuach nefesh beshabbat veen tzarich littol reshut mibbet din. vehammakdim lehatztzil hannefesh hare ze meshubbach. ketzad. raa tinok shennafal layyam pores metzuda umaalehu veaf al pi shehu tzad haddagim immo. shama shettava tinok bayyam ufaras metzuda lehaaloto veheela dagim bilvad patur mikkelum. nitkavven lehaalot dagim veheela dagim vetinok patur afillu lo shama shettava hoil veheela tinok im haddagim patur:

Nafal tinok labbor oker chulya umaalehu veaf al pi shehu metakken bah madrega bishat akirato. ninal delet bifne tinok shover haddelet umotzio veaf al pi shehu mefatztzel otah kemin etzim sheruyin limlacha shemma yibbaet hattinok veyamut. nafla deleka veyesh sham adam shechoshshin shemma yissaref mechabbin otah lehatztzilo min haesh veaf al pi shehu kovesh derech umetakkenah bishat kibbuy. vechol hakkodem lehatztzil hare ze meshubbach veeno tzarich littol reshut mibbet din bechol davar sheyyesh bo sakkana:
Mi shennafla alav mappolet safek hu sham safek eno sham mefakkechin alav. metzauhu chay af al pi shennitrotzetz vei efshar sheyyibbare mefakkechin alav umotziin oto lechayye otah shaa:

Badku ad chatmo velo matzu bo neshama mannichin oto sham shekkevar met. badku umatzu elyonim metim lo yomru kevar metu tachtonim ella mefakkechin al hakkol sheefshar bemappolet sheyyamut haelyon veyihye hattachton chay:

Hayta chatzer sheyyesh bah ovde kochavim umazzalot veyisreelim afillu yisrael echad veelef ovde kochavim umazzalot venafla alehem mappolet mefakkechin al hakkol mippene yisrael. perash echad mehem lechatzer acheret venafla alav otah chatzer mefakkechim alav shemma ze shepperash haya yisrael vehannisharim ovde kochavim umazzalot:

Neekru kullan mechatzer zo lelech lechatzer acheret uveet akiratam perash echad mehen venichnas lechatzer acheret venafla alav mappolet veen yadua mi hu en mefakkechin alav. shekkevan shenneekru kullam en kan yisrael vechol happoresh mehen keshehen mehallechin hare hu bechezkat shepperash min harov. lefichach im haya harov yisrael af al pi shenneekru kullam uferash echad mehem lechatzer acheret venafla alav mappolet mefakkechin:

Hamehallech bammidbar velo yada matay hu yom shabbat mone miyyom shettaa shishsha umekaddesh shevii umevarech bo birchot hayyom umavdil bemotzae shabbat. uvechol yom vayom vaafillu beyom ze shehu mekaddesh umavdil bo muttar lo laasot kede parnasato bilvad kede shello yamut. veasur lo laasot yoter al parnasato shekkol yom vayom sefek shabbat hu. veim yada shehu shemini litziato o chamishsha asar litziato vechayyotze beze hamminyan hare ze muttar laasot melacha beoto hayyom shehare haddavar vadday shello yatza beshayyara beshabbat. ushear hayyamim chutz miyyom ze ose kede parnasa bilvad:

Ovde kochavim umazzalot shetztzaru al ayarot yisrael im bau al iske mamon en mechallelin alehen et hashshabbat veen osin immahen milchama. uveir hassemucha lassefar afillu lo bau ella al iske teven vekash yotzin alehen bichle zayin umechallelin alehen et hashshabbat. uvechol makom im bau al iske nefashot o shearchu milchama o shetztzaru setam yotzin alehen bichle zayin umechallelin alehen et hashshabbat. umitzva al kol yisrael sheyyecholin lavo velatzet velaazor leachehem shebbammatzor ulehatztzilam miyyad haovde kochavim umazzalot beshabbat. veasur lahen lehitmahameah lemotzae shabbat. uchesheyyatztzilu et achehen muttar lahen lachazor bichle zayin shellahen limkomam beshabbat kede shello lehacheshilan leatid lavo:

Vechen sefina hametorefet bayyam o ir shehikkifah karkom o nahar mitzva latzet beshabbat lehatztzilan bechol davar sheyyachol lehatztzilan. vaafillu yachid hannirdaf mippene haovde kochavim umazzalot o mippene nachash o dov shehu rodef acharav lehargo mitzva lehatztzilo. vaafillu baasiyyat kamma melachot beshabbat vaafillu letakken kele zayin lehatztzilo muttar. vezoakim alehen umitchannenim beshabbat umatriin alehen laazor otam. veen mitchannenim velo zoakin al haddever beshabbat:

Tzarin al ayarot haovde kochavim umazzalot shelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat. veosin immahen milchama bechol yom vayom vaafillu beshabbat ad shekkovshin otah veaf al pi shehi milchemet harshut. mippi hashshemua lamdu <small>(Devarim 20 20)</small> "ad ridtah" vaafillu beshabbat. veen tzarich lomar bemilchemet mitzva. velo kavash yehoshua yericho ella beshabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 3:
Muttar lehatechil melacha meerev shabbat af al pi shehi nigmeret meeleha beshabbat. shello neesar alenu laasot melacha ella beatzmo shel yom. aval keshettease hammelacha meatzmah beshabbat muttar lanu lehanot bema shennaasa beshabbat meelav: 
Ketzad. potkin mayim lagginna erev shabbat im chashecha vehi mitmallet veholechet kol hayyom kullo. umannichin mugmar tachat hakkelim vehen mitgammerin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. umannichim kilor al gav haayin veispelanit al gabbe hammakka umitrappein veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. veshorin deyo vesammanin im chashecha vehen shorin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. venotnin tzemer leyura veunin shel pishtan lattannur vehem mishtannin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. uforsim metzudot lechayya uleofot uledagim im chashecha vehen nitztzodin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. vetoanin bekorot bet habbad uveiggule haggat im chashecha vehammashkin zavin veholchin kol hashshabbat kullah. umadlikin et hanner o et hammedura mibbaerev vehi doleket veholechet kol hashshabbat kullah: 
Mannichin kedera al gabbe haesh o basar battannur o al gabbe gechalim vehen mitbashshelim veholchin kol hashshabbat veochlin otah beshabbat. veyesh bedavar ze devarim shehen asurin gezera shemma yachte baggechalim beshabbat: 
Ketzad. tavshil shello bashel kol tzarko vechammin shello huchammu kol tzarkan o tavshil shebbashel kol tzarko vechol zeman shemmitztammek hu yafe lo en mashhin oto al gabbe haesh beshabbat af al pi shehunnach mibbeod yom gezera shemma yachte baggechalim kede lehashelim bishshulo o kede letzammeko. lefichach im garaf haesh o shekkissa esh hakkira beefer o binoret pishtan haddakka o sheammu haggechalim shehare hen kimchussot beefer o shehissikuha bekash o bigvava o biglale behema dakka shehare en sham gechalim boarot hare ze muttar lishhot aleha. shehare hissiach dato mizze hattavshil veen gozrin shemma yachte baesh: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechira shehevlah muat. aval hattannur af al pi sheggaraf haesh o kissa beefer o shehissikuhu bekash o vigvava en mashhin betocho velo al gabbav velo somchin lo tavshil shello bashel kol tzarko o shebbashel kol tzarko umitztammek veyafe lo. hoil vehevlo cham beyoter eno massiach dato vechoshshim shemma yachte bezo haesh hammeuta af al pi shehu esh kash ugevava o mechussa: 
Velamma asru lishhot battannur af al pi sheggaruf. mippene shehaggoref eno goref ella rov haesh veatzmah. vei efshar ligrof kol haesh ad shello tishshaer nitzotz achat mippene shehevlo cham shemma yachte kede levaer hannitzotzot hannisharot battannur: 
Hakkuppach hevlo rav mehevel hakkira umeat mehevel hattannur. lefichach im hissikuhu begefet o beetzim hare hu ketannur veen mashhin betocho velo al gabbav velo somchin lo tavshil shello bashel kol tzarko o mitztammek veyafe lo af al pi sheggaraf o kissa beefer. veim hissikuhu bekash o bigvava hare hu kechira shehusseka bekash ugevava umashhin alav. umuttar lismoch lechira mibbaerev veaf al pi sheenah gerufa uketuma. veezo hi kira vee zo kuppach kira mekom shefitat shete kederot kuppach mekom shefitat kedera achat: 
Tavshil chay shello bashel kelal o shebbashel kol tzarko umitztammek vera lo muttar lishhoto al gabbe haesh ben bechira vechuppach ben betannur. vechen kol tavshil shebbashel velo bashel kol tzarko o bashel kol tzarko umitztammek veyafe lo im hishlich letocho evar chay samuch leven hashshemashot naasa hakkol ketavshil chay umuttar lishhoto al haesh af al pi shello garaf velo kissa. mippene shekkevar hissiach dato mimmennu veeno ba lachtot bagechalim: 
Kol tavshil sheasur lishhoto im avar veshiha oto asur leachlo ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu. veim shechacho. im tavshil shello bashel kol tzarko hu asur ad motzae shabbat. veim tavshil shebbashel kol tzarko hu umitztammek veyafe lo muttar leachlo miyyad beshabbat: 
Kol shemmuttar lishhoto al gabbe haesh keshennotlim oto beshabbat asur lehachaziro limkomo. veen machzirin leolam ella al gabbe kira gerufa o mechussa o bechira vechuppach shehusseku bekash ugevava. vehu shello hinniach hakkedera al gabbe hakkarka aval mishshehinnicha al gabbe karka en machzirin otah. vaafillu al gabbe kira gerufa o mechussa. veen machzirin lattannur velo lechuppach shehusseku begefet o beetzim af al pi sheggaraf o kissa mippene shehevlan cham beyoter. vechol sheen machzirin alav en somchin lo beshabbat: 
Asur lehachenis magrefa likdera beshabbat vehi al haesh lehotzi mimmenna beshabbat mippene shemmegis bah veze mitztzarche habbishshul hu venimtza kimvashshel beshabbat. umuttar lehachazir mikkira lechira afillu mikkira shehevlah muat lechira shehevlah merubbe aval lo mikkira litmina velo mittemina lechira: 
Lo yemalle adam kedera asasiot veturemusin o chavit shel mayim veyitten letoch hattannur erev shabbat im chashecha veyashhe otan. sheellu vechol kayyotze bahen af al pi shello bashlu kol ikkar ketavshil shello bashel kol tzarko hen mippene sheenan tzerichim bishshul harebe vedato alehen leachlan lealtar. ulefichach asur lishhotan battannur. veim avar veshiha asurin ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu: 
Tannur shennatan letocho basar mibbeod yom veshiha oto beshabbat im besar gedi hu vechayyotze bo muttar. sheim yachte begechalim yitcharech habbasar sheeno tzarich ella chamimut haesh bilvad. veim besar ez o besar shor hu asur shemma yachte begechalim levashshelo. veim tach pi hattannur betit muttar. sheim ba liftoach hattannur velachtot tikkanes haruach veyitkashshe habbasar veyippased veyitztannen hattannur veyafsid habbasar: 
Vechen kol davar sheharuach mafsedet oto en gozrin alav shemma yegallehu veyachte. umippene ze notnin unin shel pishtan letoch hattannur im chashecha sheim gillahu yippasdu: 
Natan gedi shalem letoch hattannur hare hu kivsar ez o kivsar shor veasur lishhoto shemma yachte begechalim ella im ken tach hattannur. umuttar leshalshel keves happesach lattannur im chashecha veaf al pi sheeno tach mippene shebbene chavura zerizim hen: 
En tzolin basar uvatzal uvetza al gabbe haesh ella kede sheyyitzolu mibbeod yom veyihyu reuyin laachila. veim nisharu achar ken al haesh beshabbat ad sheyyitzolu harebe muttar mippene shehen kemitztammek vera lo sheim yachte yacharoch otan sheal guf haesh hem. umippene ze mannichin mugmar tachat hakkelim im chashecha sheim yachte begechalim yissaref hammugmar viashshen hakkelim: 
Ha lamadta shekkol davar sheanu osrin beinyan ze eno asur mishshum shehu naasa beshabbat ella gezera shemma yachte begechalim. lefichach en notnin tzemer leyura ella im ken hayta akura meal haesh shemma yachte begechalim. vehu sheyyihye piha tuach betit shemma yagis bah mishshechashecha: 
En notnin et happat battannur im chashecha velo charara al gabbe haggechalim ella kede sheyyikkarmu paneha shehem mudbakim battannur o baesh. veim nisharu achare chen ad sheyyigmor afiyyatan muttar sheim yachte yafsid otan. veim natan samuch lachashecha vechashcha vaadayin lo karmu paneha. im bemezid asur leechol mehen ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu. veim beshogeg muttar lo lirdot mimmenna mezon shalosh seuddot shel shabbat. ucheshehu rode lo yirde bemirde kederech shehu ose bechol ella besakkin vechayyotze bah: 
Ose adam medura mikkol davar sheyyirtze ben al gabbe karka ben al gabbe menora umadlikah mibbeod yom umishtammesh leorah o mitchammem kenegdah beshabbat. vetzarich sheyyadlik rov hammedura kodem chashecha ad shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha kodem hashshabbat. veim lo hidlik rubbah asur lehanot bah beshabbat gezera shemma yachte bah veyanid haetzim kede shettaale hashshalhevet. veim hidlik etz yechidi tzarich lehadelik rov avyo verov hekkefo mibbeod yom: 
Bamme devarim amurim bigvulin aval bammikdash maachizin et haur baetzim bimdurat bet hammoked im chashecha veen choshshin shemma yachte begechalim shehakkohanim zerizin hen: 
Hayta medura shel kanim o shel garinin eno tzarich lehadelik harov ella kevan shehitchil bahen haesh kodem hashshabbat muttar lehishtammesh bah. mippene shehaesh nitlet bahen bimhera veeno tzarich lachtot. lefichach im agad hakkanim o hinniach haggarinin bechotalot hare hen keetzim vetzarich shettaale bahen shalhevet meeleha kodem hashshabbat: 
Medura shel zefet o shel gafrit o shel revav o shel kira o shel kash o shel gevava eno tzarich lehadelik rubbah kodem hashshabbat mippene shehaesh madleket otam bimhera:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 4: Yesh devarim sheim taman bahen hattavshil hu mitchammem umosifin bevishshulo keen haesh. kegon haggefet vezevel umelach vesid vechol o zaggin umochin vaasavim bizman sheshshelashtan lachim vaafillu mechamat atzman. udevarim ellu nikrain davar hammosif hevel. veyesh devarim sheim taman bahen hattavshil yishshaer bachamimuto bilvad veenan mosifin lo bishshul ella monin oto millehitztannen. kegon zaggin umochin vaasavim yeveshin uchesut uferot vechanfe yona uneoret happishtan unesoret charashim ushelachin vegizze tzemer. udevarim ellu nikrain davar sheeno mosif hevel:

Min haddin haya shettomnin bedavar hammosif hevel mibbeod yom veyishshaer hattavshil tamun beshabbat. shehare mashhin al gabbe haesh beshabbat. aval asru chachamim lehatemin bedavar hammosif hevel mibbeod yom gezera shemma tartiach hakkedera beshabbat veyitztarech legalotan ad shettanuach harticha veyachazor vichasse beshabbat venimtza tomen bedavar hammosif hevel beshabbat shehu asur. lefichach muttar lehatemin bedavar hammosif hevel ben hashshemashot shessetam kederot ben hashshemashot kevar ratchu venachu mibbiabbuan vechevan shennachu shuv enan rotchin:

Vechen min haddin haya litmon hattavshil bedavar sheeno mosif hevel beshabbat atzmah. aval asru chachamim davar ze gezera shemma yatmin beremetz veyihye bo nitzotzot shel esh venimtza chote baggechalim. lefichach asru lehatemin davar cham beshabbat vaafillu bedavar sheeno mosif hevel:

Safek chashecha safek enah chashecha muttar litmon et davar cham. umuttar litmon et davar hatztzonen beshabbat bedavar sheeno mosif kede shello yitztannen beyoter o kede shettafug tzinnatan. chammin shettemanan meerev shabbat venitgallu beshabbat muttar lechassotan. shehare eno mosif. umuttar lehachalif hakkissuy beshabbat. ketzad. notel kesut umanniach kanfe yona o notel kanfe yona umanniach hakkesut:

Pinna hattavshil o hammayim hachammin mikkeli lichli acher muttar lehatemin hakkeli haacher beshabbat bedavar sheeno mosif. kemo haddavar hatztzonen. shello asru lehatemin beshabbat ella davar cham shehu bichli rishon shenitbashshel bo aval im pinnahu muttar:

Mannichin mecham al gabbe mecham beshabbat ukedera al gabbe kedera ukedera al gabbe mecham umecham al gabbe kedera vetach pihem bevatzek lo bishvil sheyyuchammu ella bishvil sheyyaamdu al chummam. shello asru ella lehatemin beshabbat aval lehanniach keli cham al gav keli cham kede sheyyihyu omdin bachamimutan muttar. aval en mannichin keli sheyyesh bo davar tzonen al gabbe keli cham beshabbat shehare molid bo chom beshabbat veim hinnicho mibbaerev muttar veeno ketomen bedavar hammosif:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:
Hadela [ka] 400 ner beshabbat enah reshut im ratza madlik veim ratza eno madlik. velo mitzva sheeno chayyav lirdof achareha ad sheyyaasena kegon eruve chatzerot o netilat yadayim laachila ella ze chova. veechad anashim veechad nashim chayyavin lihyot bevattehen ner daluk beshabbat. afillu en lo ma yochal shoel al happetachim velokeach shemen umadlik et hanner shezze bichlal oneg shabbat. vechayyav levarech kodem hadelaka baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehadelik ner shel shabbat. kederech shemmevarech al kol haddevarim shehu chayyav bahem middivre sofrim: 
Muttar lehishtammesh bener shel shabbat. vehu shello yehe haddavar tzarich iyyun harebe. aval davar shetztzarich ledakdek biriyyato asur lehavechino leor hanner gezera shemma yatte: 
Hammadlik tzarich lehadelik mibbeod yom kodem shekiat hachamma. venashim metzuuot al davar ze yoter min haanashim lefi shehen metzuyot babbattim vehen haasukot bimlechet habbayit. veaf al pi chen tzarich haish lehazehiran velivdok otan al kach velomar lahen uleanshe beto erev shabbat kodem shettechshach hadeliku et hanner. sefek chashecha venichnas hashshabbat safek lo nichnas en madlikin: 
Mishshettishka hachamma ad sheyyerau shelosha kochavim benonim hu hazzeman hannikra ben hashshemashot bechol makom. vehu safek min hayyom safek min hallayla vedanin bo lehachamir bechol makom. ulefichach en madlikin bo. vehaose melacha ben hashshemashot beerev shabbat uvemotzae shabbat beshogeg chayyav chattat mikkol makom. vechochavim ellu lo gedolim hannirim bayyom velo ketannim sheen nirin ella ballayla ella benonim. umisheyyerau shelosha kochavim ellu habbenonim hare ze layla vadday: 
Petila shemmadlikin bah leshabbat en osin otah middavar shehaur mesachsechet bo kegon tzemer vesear umeshi vetzemer haerez ufishtan shello nuppatz vesiv shel dekel umine haetz harakkim vechayyotze bahen. ella middavar shehaur nitlet bo. kegon pishta nefutza uvigde shesh vetzemer gefen vechayyotze bahen. vehammadlik tzarich sheyyadlik berov hayyotze min happetila: 
Hakkorech davar shemmadlikin bo al gabbe davar sheen madlikin bo. im lehaavot happetila kede lehosif orah asur. veim lehakeshot happetila kede shettehe omedet velo tishtalshel lematta muttar: 
Notnin gargir shel melach ugeris shel pol al pi hanner beerev shabbat sheyyihye dolek belel shabbat. vechol happetilot sheen madlikin bahen beshabbat osin mehen medura ben lehitchammem kenegdah ben lehishtammesh leorah ben al gabbe menora ben al gabbe karka. velo asru ella laasotan petila lener bilvad: 
Shemen shemmadlikin bo lishabbat tzarich sheyyehe nimshach achar happetila aval shemanin sheen nimshachin achar happetila kegon zefet veshaava veshemen kik vealya vechelev en madlikin bahen. umippene ma en madlikin biftilot sheen haur nitlet bahen velo bishmanim sheen nimshachim achar happetila gezera shemma yihye or hanner afel veyatte otah beshaa sheyyishtammesh leorah: 
Chelev shehitticho vekirve dagim shennimmochu noten letochan shemen kol shehu umadlik. aval shemanin sheen madlikin bahen afillu ervan bishmanim shemmadlikin bahen lo yadlik mippene sheen nimshachin: 
En madlikin beitran mippene sherecho ra shemma yannichennu veyetze vechova alav leshev leor hanner. velo botzori mippene sherecho tov shemma yikkach mimmennu min hanner veod mippene shehu af. velo beneft lavan vaafillu bechol mippene shehu af veyavo lide sakkana: 
Muttar lehadelik lechattechilla bishar shemanim kegon shemen tzenon veshumshemin velefet vechol kayyotze bahen. en asur ella ellu shemmanu chachamim bilvad: 
Lo yitten adam keli menukkav male shemen al pi hanner bishvil sheyyehe menattef. velo yemalle keara shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila letochah bishvil shettehe shoevet. gezera shemma yikkach min hashshemen shebbakkeli shehare lo nimas banner. veasur lehanot beshabbat min hashshemen shehudlak bo vaafillu kavta hanner vaafillu nataf min hanner mippene shehu muktze mechamat issur. veim chibber hakkeli sheyyesh bo hashshemen el hanner besid uvecharsit vechayyotze bahen muttar: 
En notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo shemen beshabbat shehare mevattel hakkeli mehechano. veim netano mibbeod yom muttar. venotnin keli tachat hanner beshabbat lekabbel bo nitzotzot mippene sheen bahen mammash vahare lo bitlo milletaltelo. veasur litten letocho mayim vaafillu meerev shabbat mippene shehu mekarev kibbuy hannitzotzot: 
En polin leor hanner velo korin leor hanner vaafillu gavoah shete komot vaafillu asara battim ze al gav ze vehanner baelyona lo yikra velo yafle leorah battachtona shemma yishkach veyatte. veim hayu shenayim korin beinyan echad muttarin likrot lifne hanner shekkol echad mehen mazkir chavero im shachach. aval lo bishne inyanim shekkol echad mehen tarud beinyano: 
Hattinokot korin lifne rabban leor hanner mippene sheharav meshammeran. aval hu lo yikra mippene sheen ematan alav. veyesh lo lirot bassefer leor hanner ad sheyyire rosh happarasha shehu tzarich lehakerotan. veachar kach noten hassefer beyadan vehem korin lefanav: 
Kelim haddomim ze laze veenan nikkarin ella beiyyun harebe asur lehakerivan leor hanner ulehavchin benehen shemma yishkach veyatte. lefichach shammash sheeno kavua asur lo livdok kosot ukearot leor hanner mippene sheeno makkiran. ben bener shel shemen zayit ben bener shel neft sheoro rav. aval shammash kavua muttar lo livdok leor hanner kosot ukearot mippene sheeno tzarich iyyun harebe. veim haya ner shel shemen zayit en morin lo livdok veaf al pi shehu muttar, gezera shemma yistappek mimmennu: 
Ner sheachore haddelet asur liftoach haddelet velinol kedarko mippene shehu mechabbehu ella yizzaher beshaa sheppoteach uveshaa shennoel. veasur liftoach et haddelet keneged hammedura beshabbat kede shettehe haruach menashshevet bah veaf al pi sheen sham ella ruach metzuya. umannichin hanner shel shabbat al gabbe ilan hamechubbar lakkarka veeno choshesh: 
Kol medinot vaayarot shel yisrael tokin bahen shesh tekiot beerev shabbat. uvemakom gavoah hayu tokin kede lehashemia kol anshe hammedina vechol anshe hammigrash shellah: 
Tekia rishona nimneu haomdim bassadot millacharosh umillaador umillaasot melacha shebbassade. veen hakkerovin rashshain likkanes lair ad sheyyavou rechokim veyikkansu kullam bevat achat. vaadayin hachanuyyot petuchot vehatterisin munnachin. hitchil litkoa sheniyya nistalleku hatterisin veninalu hachanuyyot. vaadayin hachammin vehakkederot munnachin al gabbe kira. hitchil litkoa tekia shelishit sillek hamesallek vehitmin hammatmin vehidliku et hannerot veshohe kede litzlot dag katan o kede lehadebik pat battannur. vetokea umeria vetokea veshovet: 
Tekia rishona tokea otah bemincha. vehashshelishit karov lishkiat hachamma. vechen tokin bemotzae shabbat achar tzet hakkochavim lehattir haam lemaasehen: 
Yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beerev shabbat lo hayu tokin. chal lihyot bemotzae shabbat lo tokin velo mavdilin. yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat tokin velo mavdilin. chal lihyot leachar hashshabbat mavdilin velo tokin:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6: Asur lomar lenachri laasot lanu melacha beshabbat af al pi sheeno metzuvve al hashshabbat. veaf al pi sheamar lo mikkodem hashshabbat. veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leotah melacha ella leachar hashshabbat. vedavar ze asur middivre sofrim kede shello tihye shabbat kalla beenehen veyavou laasot beatzman:

Nachri sheasa melacha meatzmo beshabbat im bishvil yisrael asa otah asur lehanot beotah melacha ad motzae shabbat veyamtin bichde shettease. vehu shello yehe haddavar befarhesya ad sheyyedu bo rabbim sheddavar ze bishvil peloni hu naasa beshabbat. veim bishvil atzmo bilvad asa muttar lehanot bah beshabbat:

Ketzad. nachri shehidlik et hanner mishtammesh leoro yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur. asa nachri kevesh lered bo min hassefina yered acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur. mille mayim lehashekot behemto mashke acharav yisrael veim bishvil yisrael asur. likket asavim lehaachil livhemto manniach yisrael behemto leechol mehen. vehu shello yehe oto hannachri makkir leoto yisrael shemma yarbe bimlachto bishvilo venimtza ose bishvil yisrael. vechen kol davar sheefshar leharebot bo lo yehane bo beshabbat ella im ken eno makkiro:

Aval davar sheen bo leharebot ulemaet kegon ner vechevesh hoil veasa bishvil atzmo nehene acharav yisrael beshabbat veaf al pi shehu makkiro. ner haddaluk bimsibba beshabbat. im rov yisrael asur lehishtammesh leorah shehammadlik al daat harov madlik. veim rov nachrim muttar lehishtammesh leorah. mechetza lemechetza asur. nafla deleka beshabbat uva nachri lechabbot en omrin lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alenu. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Met sheasu lo nachrim aron vechafru lo kever beshabbat o heviu lo chalilin lispod bahen. im betzina yamtin bichde sheyyeasu lemotzae shabbat veyikkaver bo. veim haya hakkever bisratya gedola vehaaron al gabbav vechol haovrin vehashshavin omrim shezze shehannachrim osin achshav beshabbat lifloni hu. hare ze lo yikkaver bo oto yisrael olamit. mippene shehu befarhesya. umuttar likbor bo yisrael acher vehu sheyyamtin bichde sheyyease. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Nachri shehevi chalilin beshabbat lemet af al pi shehevian mitztzad hachoma yamtin lemotzae shabbat bichde sheyyavo mimmakom karov veachar kach yispedu bahen. shemma ballayla hevium mimmakom acher ad hachoma uvabboker nichnesu bahen. veim yada bevadday shemmimmakom peloni hevium beshabbat yamtin bichde sheyyavou meoto makom achar hashshabbat. vehu shello yehe haddavar bisratya gedola kemo sheamarnu:

Ir sheyyisrael venachrim darin betochah vehayta bah merchatz hammarchetzet beshabbat. im rov nachrim muttar lirchotz bah lemotzae shabbat miyyad. veim rov yisrael yamtin bichde sheyyechammu chammin. shebbishvil harov huchammu. mechetza lemechetza yamtin bichde sheyyechammu chammin. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Yisrael sheamar lenachri laasot lo melacha zo beshabbat af al pi sheavar umakkin oto makkat mardut muttar lo lehanot beotah melacha laerev achar sheyyamtin bichde shettease. velo asru bechol makom ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu ella mippene davar ze. sheim tomar yehe muttar miyyad shemma yomar lenachri laasot lo veyimtza haddavar muchan miyyad. vechevan sheasru ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu lo yomar lenachri laasot lo shehare eno mistakker kelum mippene shehu mitakkev laerev bichde sheyyease davar ze shennaasa beshabbat:

Davar sheeno melacha veen asur laasoto beshabbat ella mishshum shevut muttar leyisrael lomar lenachri laasoto beshabbat. vehu sheyyihye sham miktzat choli o yihye tzarich laddavar tzorech harebe o mippene mitzva:

Ketzad. omer yisrael lenachri beshabbat laalot bailan o lashut al pene hammayim kede lehavi lo shofar. o sakkin lemila. o mevi lo mechatzer lechatzer sheen eruv benehen mayim chammin leharechitz bahem katan umitztaer. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hallokeach bayit beeretz yisrael min hannachri muttar lo lomar lannachri lichtov lo shetar beshabbat. sheamira lenachri beshabbat asura middivrehem umishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael lo gazru bedavar ze. vechen hallokeach bayit mehem besureya, shessureya keeretz yisrael ledavar ze:

Posek adam im hannachri al hammelacha vekotzetz damim vehannachri ose leatzmo veaf al pi shehu ose beshabbat muttar. vechen hassocher et hannachri leyamim harebe muttar af al pi shehu ose beshabbat. ketzad. kegon shessachar hannachri leshana o lishtayim sheyyichtov lo o sheyyeerog lo. hare ze kotev veoreg beshabbat umuttar keillu katzatz immo sheyyichtov lo sefer o sheyyeerog lo beged shehu ose bechol et sheyyirtze. vehu shello yachshov immo yom yom:

Bamme devarim amurim betzina sheen makkirim hakkol shezzo hammelacha hannaaset beshabbat shel yisrael hi. aval im hayta yedua ugeluya umefursemet asura sheharoe et hannachri osek eno yodea shekkatzatz veomer sheppeloni sachar hannachri laasot lo melacha beshabbat:

Lefichach happosek im hannachri livnot lo chatzero o katlo o liktzor et sadehu o shessecharo shana o shetayim livnot lo chatzer o litta lo kerem. im hayta hammelacha bammedina o betoch hattechum asur lo lahanichan laasot beshabbat mippene haroim sheenam yodim sheppasak. veim hayta hammelacha chutz lattechum muttar sheen sham yisrael sheyyire et happoalin keshehen osin beshabbat:

Vechen muttar leadam lehasekir karmo o sadehu lenachri af al pi shehu zoran venotan beshabbat. sheharoe yodea shessechurin hen o baarisut natan lahen. vedavar sheshshem yisrael bealav karuy alav veen derech rov anshe oto hammakom lehasekiro o litteno baarisut asur lehasekiro lenachri. mippene shehannachri ose beoto hammakom melacha beshabbat vehu nikra al shem hayyisrael bealav:

Muttar lehasheil kelim ulehaskiran lenachri veaf al pi shehu ose bahen melacha beshabbat mippene sheen anu metzuvvim al shevitat hakkelim. aval behemto veavdo asur mippene sheanu metzuvvin al shevitat behema veeved:

Hammishtattef im hannachri bimlacha o bischora o bachanut. im hitnu battechilla sheyyihye sechar hashshabbat lannachri levaddo im meat im harebe usechar yom acher keneged yom hashshabbat leyisrael levaddo muttar. veim lo hitnu battechilla. kesheyyavou lachalok notel hannachri sechar hashshabbatot kullan levaddo vehashshear cholkin oto. veeno mosif lo kelum keneged yom hashshabbat ella im ken hitnu battechilla. vechen im kibbelu sade beshuttafut din echad hu:

Veim lo hittenu uvau lachalok hassachar velo haya sechar shabbat yadua yerae li shehannachri notel levaddo sheviit hassachar vehashshear cholkin. hannoten maot lenachri lehitassek bahen af al pi shehannachri nose venoten beshabbat cholek immo bassachar beshave vechen horu kol haggeonim:

Lo yitten adam beerev shabbat kelim leumman nachri laasotan af al pi sheppasak immo. ella bichde sheyyetze bahen mibbeto kodem shechashecha. vechen lo yimkor adam chafatzav lenachri velo yashilennu velo yalvennu velo yemashkenennu velo yitten lo bemattana ella bichde sheyyetze beoto chefetz mippetach beto kodem hashshabbat. shekkol zeman shehu beveto en adam yodea ematay natan lo uchesheyyetze hannachri mibbeto beshabbat vechefetz yisrael beyado yerae kemi shehillevahu lannachri o mishkeno o pasak immo o machar lo beshabbat:

Hannoten iggeret lenachri leholichah leir acheret im katzatz immo sechar holacha muttar. vaafillu netanah lo erev shabbat im chashecha. vehu sheyyetze bah mippetach beto kodem hashshabbat. veim lo katzatz im yesh bammedina adam kavua shehu mekabbetz haiggerot vesholeach otam lechol medina umedina im sheluchav muttar litten lannachri haiggeret. vehu sheyyihye shehut bayyom kede sheyyaggia labbayit hassamuch lachoma kodem hashshabbat. shemma ze shemmekabbel haiggerot vesholchan beto samuch lachoma hu. veim en sham adam kavua lechach ella hannachri shennotnin lo haiggeret hu shemmolichah leir acheret asur lishloach beyad nachri haiggeret leolam ella im ken katzatz lo damim:

Nachri shehevi chafatzav beshabbat vehichnisan levet yisrael muttar. vaafillu amar lo hannichan bezavit zo hare ze muttar. umezammenin et hannachri beshabbat venotnin lefanav mezonot leachlan. veim netalan veyatza en nizkakin lo mippene sheen shevitato alenu. vechen notnin mezonot lifne hakkelev bechatzer veim netalan veyatza en nizkakin lo:

Mi shehaya ba badderech vekadash alav hayyom vehayu immo maot noten kiso lenachri leholicho lo ulemotzae shabbat lokcho mimmennu. veaf al pi shello natan lo sachar al ze. veaf al pi shennetano lo mishshechashecha muttar mippene sheadam bahul al mamono vei efshar sheyyashlichennu. veim lo tattir lo davar ze sheen issuro ella middivre sofrim yavo lahavio beyado veover al melacha shel tora. bamme devarim amurim bechiso aval metzia lo yitten lannachri ella molichah befachot pachot mearba ammot:

Yisrael sheasa melacha beshabbat im avar veasa bezadon asur lo lehanot beotah melacha leolam. ushear yisrael muttar lahem lehanot bah lemotzae shabbat miyyad shenneemar <small>(Shemot lo 14)</small> "ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi", hi kodesh veen maaseha kodesh. ketzad. yisrael shebbishshel beshabbat bemezid. lemotzae shabbat yeachel laacherim aval lo lo yeachel olamit. veim bishshel bishgaga lemotzae shabbat yochal ben hu ben acherim miyyad. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum vechazru. beshogeg yeachlu beshabbat shehare lo naasa begufan maase velo nishtannu. bemezid lo yeachlu ad motzae shabbat:

Hassocher et happoel lishmor lo et happara veet hattinok lo yitten lo secharo shel shabbat. lefichach en acharayut shabbat alav. veim haya hassachir sechir shabbat o sechir shana noten lo secharo mashlam. lefichach acharayut shabbat alav. velo yomar lo ten li sechari shel shabbat ella omer lo ten li sechari shel shana o shel asara yamim:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 7:
Melachot shechayyavin alehen sekila vecharet bemezid o karban chattat bishgaga. mehen avot umehen toladot. uminyan kol avot melachot arbaim chaser achat. veellu hen. hacharisha. vehazzeria. vehakketzira. vehaimmur. vehaddisha. vehazzeriyya. vehabberira. vehattechina. vehaharkada. vehallisha. vehaafiyya. vehaggeziza. vehallibbun. vehannipputz. vehatztzevia. vehatteviyya. vaasiyyat hannirin. vehanesachat hammassecha. vehaariga. vehabbetzia. vehakkeshira. vehahattara. vehattefira. vehakkeria. vehabbinyan. vehassetira. vehakkaa befattish. vehatztzida. vehashshechita. vehahafshata. vehahaavada. umechikat haor. vechittucho. vehakketiva. vehammechika. vehassirtut. vehahavara. vehakkibbuy. vehahotzaa mershut lirshut: 
Kol ellu hammelachot vechol shehu meinyanam hem hannikrain avot melachot. ketzad hu inyanan. echad hachoresh o hachofer o haose charitz hare ze av melacha. shekkol achat veachat mehen chafira bakkarka veinyan echad hu: 
Vechen hazzorea zeraim o hannotea ilanot o hammavrich ilanot o hammarkiv o hazzomer. kol ellu av echad hen meavot melachot veinyan echad hu. shekkol achat mehen letzammeach davar hu mitkavven: 
Vechen hakkotzer tevua o kitnit o habbotzer anavim o haggoder temarim o hammosek zetim o haore teenim. kol ellu av melacha achat hen. shekkol achat mehen laakor davar miggiddulav mitkavven. veal derech zo shear haavot: 
Hattolada hi hammelacha haddoma leav meellu haavot. ketzad. hamechattech et hayyarak meat levashshelo hare ze chayyav shezzo hammelacha toledet techina. shehattochen lokeach guf echad umechalleko legufim harebe. vechol haose davar haddome laze hare ze toledet tochen. vechen hallokeach lashon shel mattechet veshaf oto kede likkach meafaro kederech sheosim tzorfe hazzahav hare ze toledet techina: 
Vechen hallokeach chalav venatan bo keva kede lechavtzo hare ze chayyav mishshum toledet borer shehare hifrish hakkom min hechalav. veim gibbeno veasahu gevina chayyav mishshum bone. shekkol hamekabbetz chelek el chelek vedibbek hakkol ad sheyyeasu guf echad hare ze dome levinyan. vechen lechol melacha umelacha meellu haavot yesh lahen toladot al derech zo sheamarnu. umigguf hammelacha hannaaset beshabbat teda meen e ze av hi vetoledet e ze av hi: 
Echad haose av meavot melachot o tolada min hattoladot bemezid chayyav karet. veim bau edim niskal. beshogeg chayyav chattat kevua. im ken ma hefresh yesh ben haavot vehattoladot. en benehen hefresh ella leinyan hakkarban bilvad. shehaose beshogeg im asa avot harebe behealem echad chayyav chattat achat al kol av veav. veim asa av vetoldotav behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat: 
Ketzad. hare shecharash vezara vekatzar beshabbat behealem echad chayyav shalosh chattaot. vaafillu asa haarbaim chaser achat bishgaga kegon sheshshachach sheellu hammelachot asurot leasot beshabbat chayyav al kol melacha umelacha chattat achat. aval im tachan vechatach hayyarak veshaf lashon shel mattechet behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat. shehare lo asa ella av echad vetoldotav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat. ketzad. hare shezzara venata vehivrich vehirkiv vezamar behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat shekkullan av echad hen. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:
Hachoresh kol shehu chayyav. hamenakkesh beikkere hailanot vehamekarsem asavim o hamezared et hassarigim kede leyappot et hakkarka hare ze toledet choresh umishsheyyaase kol shehu chayyav. vechen hammashve pene hassade kegon shehishpil hattel veriddedo o mille haggay chayyav mishshum choresh. veshiuro kol shehu. vechen kol hammashve gummot shiuro kol shehu: 
Hazzorea kol shehu chayyav. hazzomer et hailan kede sheyyitzmach hare ze meen zorea. aval hammashke tzemachin veilanot beshabbat hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechol shehu. vechen hashshore chittin useorin vechayyotze bahen bammayim hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechol shehu: 
Hakkotzer kigrogeret chayyav. vetolesh toledet kotzer hu. vechol haoker davar miggiddulo chayyav mishshum kotzer. lefichach tzeror shealu bo asavim ucheshut sheala bassene vaasavim shetztzamchu al gav hechavit. hattolesh mehen chayyav shezze hu mekom giddulan. aval hattolesh meatzitz sheeno nakuv patur mippene sheen ze mekom giddulo. veatzitz nakuv bichde shoresh katan hare hu keeretz vehattolesh mimmennu chayyav: 
Kol zera shekketzirato matzmachat oto umegaddalto kegon aspasta vesilka. hakkotzro bishgaga chayyav shete chattaot. achat mippene shehu kotzer veachat mippene shehu notea. vechen hazzomer vehu tzarich laetzim chayyav mishshum kotzer umishshum notea. gavshushit shel afar shealu bah asavim, higbihah meal haaretz vehinnichah al gabbe yetedot chayyav mishshum tolesh. hayta al gabbe yetedot vehinnichah al haaretz chayyav mishshum zorea. teenim sheyyavshu beibbehen vechen ilan sheyyavshu perotav bo. hattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyav af al pi shehen kaakurin leinyan tuma: 
Hattolesh ulshin hamezared zeradin. im laachila shiuro kigrogeret. veim livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi. veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza. hameammer ochalin im laachila shiuro kigrogeret. veim immer livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi. veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza. uvetza haamura bechol makom hi betza benonit shel tarnegolin. vechol makom shenneemar kede levashshel betza hu kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza ugerogeret echad mishshelosha bevetza. veen immur ella begiddule karka: 
Hamekabbetz devela veasa mimmenna iggula o shennikkev teenim vehichnis hachevel bahen ad shennitkabbetzu guf echad. hare ze toledet meammer vechayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haddash kigrogeret chayyav veen disha ella begiddule karka. vehamefarek hare hi toledet haddash vechayyav vechen kol kayyotze baze. hacholev et habbehema chayyav mishshum mefarek vechen hachovel bechay sheyyesh lo or chayyav mishshum mefarek. vehu sheyyihye tzarich laddam sheyyetze min hachabbura. aval im nitkavven lehazzik bilvad patur mippene shehu mekalkel. veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye baddam o bachalav shehotzi kigrogeret: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechovel bivhema vechayya veof vechayyotze bahem. aval hachovel bachavero af al pi shennitkavven lehazzik chayyav mippene nachat rucho shehare nitkarra dato veshachcha chamato vahare hu kimtakken. veaf al pi sheeno tzarich laddam shehotzi mimmennu chayyav: 
Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora hen sheyyesh lahen orot leinyan shabbat kemo chayya uvehema veof. aval shear shekatzim uremasim en lahen or. lefichach hachovel bahen patur. veechad hachovel bivhema chayya veof o bishmona sheratzim veasa bahen chabbura veyatza mehem dam o shennitzrar haddam af al pi shello yatza chayyav: 
Hassochet et happerot lehotzi memehen chayyav mishshum mefarek. veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye bammashkin shessachat kigrogeret. veen chayyavim min hattora ella al derichat zetim vaanavim bilvad. umuttar lischot eshkol shel anavim letoch haochel. shemmashke habba leochel ochel hu venimtza kimfarek ochel meochel. aval im sachat lichli sheen bo ochel hare ze dorech vechayyav. vehacholev letoch haochel o hayyonek befiv patur veeno chayyav ad sheyyachalov letoch hakkeli: 
Hazzore o habborer kigrogeret chayyav. vehamechabbetz hare hu toledet borer. vechen habborer shemarim mittoch hammashkin hare ze toledet borer o toledet merakked vechayyav. shehazzore vehabborer vehamerakked domin inyenehem ze laze. umippene ma manu otan bishlosha mippene shekkol melacha shehayta bammishkan monin otah bifne atzmah: 
Habborer ochel mittoch pesolet o shehayu lefanav shene mine ochalin uverer min mimmin acher benafa uvichvara chayyav. bekanon o betamchuy patur. veim berer beyado leechol lealtar muttar: 
Vehabborer pesolet mittoch haochel vaafillu beyado achat chayyav. vehabborer turmosin mittoch pesolet shellahen chayyav mippene shehappesolet shellahen mematteket otan kesheyyishleku otan immahem venimtza kevorer pesolet mittoch ochel vechayyav. habborer ochel mittoch pesolet beyado lehannicho afillu levo bayyom naasa kevorer laotzar vechayyav. hayu lefanav shene mine ochalin meoravin borer echad meacher umanniach leechol miyyad. veim berer vehinniach leachar zeman afillu levo bayyom kegon shebberer beshacharit leechol ben haarbayim chayyav: 
Hmshammer yayin o shemen o mayim vechen shear hammashkin bammeshammeret shellahen chayyav. vehu sheyyeshammer kigrogeret. aval mesannenin yayin sheen bo shemarim o mayim tzelulin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit kede sheyyehe tzalul beyoter. venotnin mayim al gabbe shemarim bishvil sheyyitztzolu. venotnin betza terufa limsannenet shel chardal kede sheyyitztzalel. chardal shellasho meerev shabbat. lemachar memache veshote ben bayyad ben bichli. vechen yayin miggitto kol zeman shehu toses toref chavit bishmareha venoten letoch hassudarin. sheadayin lo nifreshu hashshemarim min hayyayin yafe yafe vechol hayyayin keguf echad hu. vechen hachardal vechol kayyotze bo: 
Hattochen kigrogeret chayyav. vechol hashshochek tavlin vesammanin bemachteshet hare ze tochen vechayyav. hamechattech yarak talush hare ze toledet tochen. vechen hannoser etzim lehanot binsoret shellahen o hashshaf lashon shel mattechet chayyav mishsheyyashuf kol shehu. aval hamechattech etzim eno chayyav ad sheyyedakdek mehen kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza: 
Hamerakked kigrogeret chayyav. hallash kigrogeret chayyav hamegabbel et heafar hare ze toledet lash. vechamma shiuro kede laasot pi kur shel tzorfe zahav. veen gibbul beefer velo bechol haggas velo bemursan velo bechayyotze bahen. vehannoten zera shumshemin o zera pishtan vechayyotze bahen bemayim chayyav mishshum lash. mippene shehen mitarvin venitlin ze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:
Haofe kigrogeret chayyav. echad haofe et happat o hamevashshel et hammaachol o et hassammanin o hamechammem et hammayim hakkol inyan echad hu. shiur hamechammem et hammayim kede lirchotz bahen evar katan. veshiur mevashshel sammanin kede sheyyihyu reuyin ledavar shemmevashshelin otan lo: 
Hannoten betza betzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel venitgalgela chayyav. shehamevashshel betoledet haur kimvashshel baur atzmah. vechen hammediach bechammin dag maliach hayyashan o kuleyays haispanin vehu dag dak verach beyoter hare ze chayyav. shehadachatan bechammin ze hu gemar bishshulan. vechen kol kayyotze bahen: 
Hammafkia et habbetza beveged cham o bechol uvaavak derachim shehen chammim mippene hashshemesh af al pi shennitzlet patur. shettoldot chamma enam ketoldot haesh. aval gazru alehen mippene toldot haur. vechen hamevashshel bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahem patur. hamevashshel al haur davar shehaya mevushshal kol tzarko o davar sheeno tzarich bishshul kelal patur: 
Echad natan et haur veechad natan et haetzim veechad natan et hakkedera veechad natan et hammayim veechad natan et habbasar veechad natan et hattavlin uva acher vehegis kullam chayyavim mishshum mevashshel. shekkol haose davar mitztzarche habbishshul hare ze mevashshel. aval im shafat echad et hakkedera techilla uva acher venatan et hammayim uva acher venatan et habbasar uva acher venatan et hattavlin uva acher venatan et haur uva acher venatan etzim al haur uva acher vehegis. shenayim haacharonim bilvad chayyavin mishshum mevashshel: 
Hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim im nitzla bo kigrogeret afillu bishnayim ushelosha mekomot chayyav. lo nitzla bo kigrogeret aval nitbashshel kullo chatzi bishshul chayyav. nitbashshel chatzi bishshul mitztzad echad patur. ad sheyyahafoch bo veyitbashshel chatzi bishshul mishshene tzedadin. shachach vehidbik pat battannur beshabbat venizkar muttar lo lirdota kodem shetteafe veyavo lide melacha: 
Hammattich echad mimmine mattachot kol shehu o hamechammem et hammattachot ad shettease gachelet hare ze toledet mevashshel. vechen hamemasses et haddonag o et hachelev o et hazzefet vehakkofer vehaggafrit vechayyotze bahem hare ze toledet mevashshel vechayyav. vechen hamevashshel kele adama ad sheyyeasu cheres chayyav mishshum mevashshel. kelalo shel davar ben sherippa guf kashe baesh o shehiksha guf rach hare ze chayyav mishshum mevashshel: 
Haggozez tzemer o sear ben min habbehema ben min hachayya ben min hachay ben min hammet afillu min hashshelach shellahen chayyav. kamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut shearko kerochav hassit kaful. vechamma rochav hassit kede limtoach min bohen shel yad ad haetzba harishona kesheyyiftach benehen bechol kocho vehu karov lishne shelishe zeret. hattolesh kanaf min haof hare ze toledet gozez. hattove et hatztzemer min hachay patur sheen derech geziza bechach veen derech nipputz bechach veen derech teviyya bechach: 
Hannotel tzipparnav o searo o sefamo o zekano hare ze toledet gozez vechayyav. vehu sheyyittol bichli. aval im netalan beyado ben lo ben leacher patur. vechen hachotech yabbelet miggufo ben beyad ben bichli patur ben lo ben leacher. umuttar lachtoch yabbelet bammikdash beyad aval lo bichli. veim hayta yevesha chotchah af bichli veoved avoda: 
Hannotel searo bichli kamma yittol veyihye chayyav. shete searot. veim likket levanot mittoch shechorot afillu achat chayyav. tzipporen sheppersha rubbah vetzitzin shel or sheppershu rubban im pershu kelappe mala umetzaarot oto muttar littol otan beyado aval lo bichli. veim netalan bichli patur. veim enan metzaarot oto afillu bayyad asur. veim lo pershu rubban afillu metzaarot oto asur lenatlan beyado veim netalan bichli chayyav: 
Hamelabben et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani. vechen kol kayyotze bahen mimma sheddarkan lehitlabben chayyav. vechamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut echad arko kimlo rochav hassit kaful shehu orech arbaa tefachim: 
Hamechabbes begadim hare hu toledet melabben vechayyav. vhassochet et habbeged ad sheyyotzi hammayim shebbo hare ze mechabbes vechayyav. shehassechita mitztzarche kibbus hi kemo shehahagasa mitztzarche habbishshul. veen sechita besear vehu haddin leor sheen chayyavin al sechitato: 
Hamenappetz et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani vechayyotze bahen chayyav. vechamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut echad arko arbaa tefachim. vehamenappetz et haggidim ad sheyyeasu ketzemer kede litvot otan hare ze toledet menappetz vechayyav: 
Hatztzovea chut shearko arbaa tefachim o davar sheefshar litvot mimmennu chut kaze chayyav. veen hatztzovea chayyav ad sheyyehe tzeva hammitkayyem. aval tzeva sheeno mitkayyem kelal kegon sheheevir sarak o shashar al gabbe barzel o nechoshet utzevao patur. shehare atta maaviro lishato veeno tzovea kelum. vechol sheen melachto mitkayyemet beshabbat patur: 
Haose en hatztzeva hare ze toledet tzovea vechayyav. ketzad. kegon shennatan kankantom letoch me appetza shennaasa hakkol shachor. o shennatan istis letoch me karkom shennaasa hakkol yarok. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechamma shiuro kede litzboa bo chut shearko arbaa tefachim: 
Hattove orech arbaa tefachim mikkol davar hannitve chayyav. echad hattove et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hannotza o et hassear o et haggidin. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. haose et halleved hare ze toledet tove vechayyav. vehu sheyyelabbed davar sheefshar litvot mimmennu chut orech arbaa tefachim beovi benoni: 
Haose shene batte nirin chayyav. haose nafa o kevara o sal o sevacha o shessarag mitta bachavalim hare ze toledet ose nirin umishsheyyaase shene battim beechad mikkol ellu chayyav. vechen kol haose shene batte nirin bedavar sheosin oto battim battim kegon ellu chayyav: 
Derech haorgin shemmotchin hachutin techilla beorech hayeria uverachbah ushenayim ochazin ze mikkan veze mikkan veechad shovet beshevet al hachutin umetakken otan ze betzad ze ad shettease kullah sheti belo erev. umetichat hachutin kederech haorgin hi hanesachat hammassechet veze hammoteach nikra mesech. ucheshekkoflin otah umatchil lehachenis hashsheti baerev nikra oreg: 
Hammesech chayyav vehi melacha meavot melachot. vehashshovet al hachutin ad sheyyipparku vitakkenem hare ze toledet mesech. vechamma shiuro mishsheyyetakken rochav shete etzbaot. vechen haoreg shene chutin berochav shete etzbaot chayyav. ben shearagan battechilla ben shehaya miktzat habbeged arug vearag al haarug shiuro shene chutin. veim arag chut echad vehishlim bo habbeged chayyav. arag bisfat hayeria shene chutin berochav shelosha batte nirin chayyav. ha lema ze dome leoreg tziltzul katan berochav shelosha batte nirin: 
Hamedakdek et hachutin umafridan beet haariga hare ze toledet oreg. vechen hakkolea et hannimin hare ze toledet oreg veshiuro mishsheyyaase kelia beorech shete etzbaot:
