Kol kele hammilchama en yotzin bahen beshabbat. veim yatza im hayu kelim shehen derech malbush kegon shiryon vechova umaggafayim sheal haraglayim hare ze patur. veim yatza bechelim sheenan derech malbush kegon romach vesayif vekeshet vealla uteris hare ze chayyav: 
En yotzin besandal mesummar shessemaro lechazzeko. vaafillu beyom tov gazru alav shello yetze bo. umuttar latzet beavnet sheyyesh alav chatichot kevuot shel kesef veshel zahav kemo shehammelachim osin. mippene shehu tachshit vechol shehu tachshit muttar. vehu shello yehe rafuy shemma yippol birshut harabbim veyavo lahavio: 
Tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam mittachshite haish hi veenah mittachshite haishsha. vesheen aleha chotam mittachshite ishsha veenah mittachshite haish. lefichach ishsha sheyyatzat betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam. veish sheyyatza betabbaat sheen aleha chotam chayyavin. umippene ma hen chayyavin vahare hotziu otan shello kederech hammotziin sheen derech haish lehotzi beetzbao ella tabbaat haruya lo vechen haishsha en darkah lehotzi beetzbaah ella tabbaat haruya lah. mippene sheppeamim noten haish tabbato leishto lehatzeniah babbayit umannachat otah beetzbaah beet holacha. vechen haishsha notenet tabbatah levalah letakkenah etzel haumman umanniach otah beetzbao beet holacha ad chanut haumman venimtzeu shehotziu otan kederech sheddarkan lehotzian ulefichach chayyavin: 
Lo tetze ishsha betabbaat sheen aleha chotam af al pi shehu mittachshiteha gezera shemma totziah birshut harabbim lehareot lechavroteha kederech shehannashim osot tamid. veim yatzat bah petura. aval haish muttar latzet betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam mippene shehu tachshit veen darko leheraot. venahagu kol haam shello yetzu betabbaat kelal: 
Ishsha sheyyatza bemachat nekuva chayyevet vehaish patur. veish sheyyatza bemachat sheenah nekuva chayyav vehaishsha petura mippene shehi mittachshiteha veenah asura ella gezera shemma tare lechavroteha. ze hakkelal kol hayyotze bedavar sheeno mittachshitav veeno derech malbush vehotzio kederech shemmotziin oto davar chayyav. vechol hayyotze bedavar shehu mittachshitav vehaya rafuy veefshar sheyyippol bimhera veyavo lahavio birshut harabbim. vechen ishsha sheyyatzat betachshitin sheddarkan lishlof otan uleharotan hare ellu peturin. vechol davar shehu tachshit veeno nofel veen darkah lehareoto hare ze muttar latzet bo. lefichach etzada shemmannichin otah bazzeroa o bashshok yotzin bah beshabbat vehu shettihye devuka labbasar velo tishshamet. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Lo tetze ishsha bechute tzemer o bechute pishtan o birtzuot hakkeshurot lah al roshah shemma tachlotz otah bishat tevila vetaavirah birshut harabbim. velo betzitz shemmannachat ben eneha velo bilchayayim shel zahav sheyyordin min hatztzitz al lechayeha bizman sheenan tefurin ze baze. velo baatara shel zahav shemmunnachat beroshah velo bichvalim sheyyotzin bahen habbanot beraglehen kede shello yifseu pesia gassa shello yafsidu betulehen. kol ellu asurin latzet bahen beshabbat shemma yippelu utevien beyadah: 
Lo tetze ishsha bekatla shebbetzavvara velo benizme haaf velo bitzlochit shel pelayyayton hakkevua al zeroah. velo bakkis hakkatan heagol shemmannichin bo shemen hattov vehu hannikra kovelet. velo befea shel sear shemmannachat al roshah kede shetterae baalat sear harebe. velo bechavul shel tzemer shemmakkefet oto saviv lefaneha. velo beshen shemmannachat befiha bimkom shen shennafal. velo beshen shel zahav shemmannachat al shen shachor o adom sheyyesh beshshinneha. aval shen shel kesef muttar mippene sheeno nikkar. kol ellu asurin latzet bahen shemma yippelu uteviem beyadah o tachlotz vetare lechavroteha: 
Kol sheasru chachamim latzet bo lirshut harabbim asur lo latzet bo afillu bechatzer sheenah meorevet. chutz mikkavul ufea shel sear shemmuttar latzet bahen lechatzer sheenah meorevet kede shello titganne al balah. vehayyotzet bitzlochit shel pelayyayton sheen bah boshom kelal chayyevet: 
Yotza ishsha bechute sear hakkeshurim lah al roshah mippene shehammayim bain bahen veenan chotztzin veenah cholatztan im era lah tevila ad shennigzor shemma teviem lirshut harabbim. ben shehayu hachutin shellah ben shel chavertah ben shel behema. velo tetze hazzekena beshel yalda sheshshevach hen lah veshemma tachlotz vetarem lechavroteha. aval yalda yotzet bechute zekena. vechol shehu arug yotzet bo al roshah: 
Yotza ishsha bechutin shebbetzavvara mippene sheenah choneket atzmah bahen veenan chotztzin. veim hayu tzevuin asurim shemma tare otan lechavroteha. veyotza ishsha bechalil shel zahav beroshah sheen yotza bo ella ishsha chashuva sheen darkah lachalotz uleharot. veyotza betzitz uvilchayayim shel zahav bizman shehen tefurin bisvacha sheal roshah kede shello yippolu. vechen kol kayyotze bahem: 
Yotza ishsha bemoch shebbeaznah vehu sheyyihye kashur beaznah. uvemoch shebbesandalah vehu sheyyihye kashur besandalah. uvemoch shehitkina leniddatah veaf al pi sheeno kashur vaafillu asta lo bet yad sheim nafal enah mevia oto mippene meisuto: 
Veyotza befilpel uvegargir melach uvechol davar shettitten letoch piha mippene reach happe. velo titten lechattechilla beshabbat. yotzot hannashim bekesamin shebbeaznehen uviralot shebbetzavvaran o shebbichsutan uvardid happaruf uforefet battechilla beshabbat al haeven veal haegoz veyotza. velo taarim vetifrof al haegoz kede lehotzio livnah hakkatan. vechen lo tifrof al hammatbea lechattechilla mippene sheasur letaltelo. veim parfa yotza bo: 
Yotze adam bekesam shebbeshinnav veshebbesandalo lirshut harabbim. veim nafal lo yachazir. uvemoch uvisfog sheal gabbe hammakka uvilvad shello yichroch alehen chut o meshicha shehare hachut vehammeshicha chashuvin etzlo veenam moilin lammakka. veyotze biklippat hashshum uviklippat habbatzal sheal hammakka uveeged sheal gabbe makka vekoshro umattiro beshabbat. uveispelanit umelugema uretiyya sheal gabbe hammakka uvesela sheal hitztzinit uvevetzat hachargol uveshen hashshual uvemasmer hatztzaluv. uvechol davar shettolin oto mishshum refua vehu sheyyomru harofim shehu moil: 
Yotzet haishsha beeven tekuma uvemishkal even tekuma shennitkavven ushekalo lirfua. velo ishsha ubbara bilvad ella afillu shear hannashim shemma titabber vetappil. veyotzin bekamea mumche. vee ze hu kamea mumche ze sherippe lishlosha bene adam o sheasahu adam sherippe shelosha bene adam bikmein acherim. veim yatza bekamea sheeno mumche patur. mippene shehotzio derech malbush. vechen hayyotze bitfillin patur: 
Mi sheyyesh beraglo makka yotze besandal yechidi beraglo habberia. veim en beraglo makka lo yetze besandal yachid. velo yetze katan beminal gadol aval yotze hu bechaluk gadol. velo tetze ishsha beminal rafuy velo beminal chadash shello yatza bo shaa achat mibbeod yom. veen hakkittea yotze bekav shello. ankkatmin shel etz en yotzin bahen beshabbat mippene sheenan middarche hammalbush. veim yatzu peturin: 
Yotzin bifkarion uvetzifa shebberashe baale chatatin. ematay bizman shetztzevaan beshemen ucherachan o sheyyatza bahen shaa achat mibbeod yom. aval im lo asa bahen maase velo yatza bahen kodem hashshabbat asur latzet bahen: 
Yotzin besak ave uviria uvesagos ave uvachamila mippene haggeshamim. aval lo beteva velo bekuppa velo bemachtzelet mippene haggeshamim. hakkar vehakkeset im hayu rakkin vedakkin kemo habbegadim muttar lehotzian munnachin al rosho beshabbat derech malbush. veim hayu kashin hare hen kemassooy vaasurin: 
Yotzin bezogin haarugin babbegadim. veyotze haeved bechotam shel tit shebbetzavvaro aval lo bechotam shel mattechet shemma yippol viviennu. hammitattef betallito vekippelah mikkan umikkan beyado o al ketefo im nitkavven lekabbetz kenafav kede shello yikkaru o shello yitlachlechu asur. veim kibbetzan lehitnaot bahen keminhag anshe hammakom bemalbushan muttar: 
Hayyotze betallit mekuppelet umunnachat al ketefo chayyav. aval yotze hu besudar sheal ketefo af al pi sheen nima keshura lo beetzbao. vechol sudar sheeno chofe rosho verubbo asur latzet bo. hayta sachnit ketzara sheenah rechava kosher shene rasheha lematta mikketefayim venimtzet kemo avnet umuttar latzet bah: 
Muttar lehitattef betallit sheyyesh besiftoteha melel af al pi shehen chutin arukkin veaf al pi sheenan noy hattallit mippene shehen betelim legabbe hattallit veeno makpid alehen ben hayu ben lo hayu. lefichach hayyotze betallit sheenah metzuyyetzet kehilchatah chayyav mippene sheotan hachutin chashuvin hen etzlo vedato alehen ad sheyyashlim chesronan veyeasu tzitzit. aval tallit hametzuyyetzet kehilchatah muttar latzet bah ben bayyom ben ballayla. sheen hatztzitzit haggemura massooy ella hare hi minnoy habbeged umittachsisav kemo haimra vechayyotze bah. veillu hayu chute hatztzitzit shehi metzuyyetzet kehilchatah massooy haya chayyav hayyotze bah afillu beyom hashshabbat sheen mitzvat ase sheen bah karet docha shabbat: 
Lo yetze hachayyat beshabbat bemachat hattechuva lo bevigdo. velo naggar bekesam shebbeazno. velo gardi baira shebbeazno. velo sorek bimshicha shebbeazno. velo shulchani bedinar shebbetzavvaro. velo tzabba bedugma shebbeazno. veim yatza patur af al pi sheyyatza derech ummanuto mippene shello hotzi kederech hammotziin: 
Hazzav sheyyatza bechis shello chayyav mippene sheen derech kis ze lehotzio ella kadderech hazzot veaf al pi sheeno tzarich leguf hahotzaa ella kede shello yitlachlechu begadav shehammelacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha: 
Hammotze tefillin beshabbat birshut harabbim ketzad hu ose. lovshan kedarkan, meniach shel yad beyado shel rosh berosho venichnas vecholtzan bevayit vechozer veyotze velovesh zug sheni vecholtzan ad sheyyachnis et kullan. veim hayu harebe velo nishar min hayyom kede lehachenisan derech malbush hare ze machshich alehem umachnisan bemotzae shabbat. veim haya bime haggezera shemmityare leshev uleshamran ad haerev mippene hakkutim mechassan bimkoman umannichan veholech: 
Haya mityare lehacheshich alehen mippene hallistim notel et kullan keachat umolichan pachot pachot mearba ammot o notnan lachavero betoch arba ammot vachavero lachavero ad shemmaggia lechatzer hachitzona. bamme devarim amurim beshehayu bahen retzuotehen vehen mekushsharin kesher shel tefillin shevvadday tefillin hen aval im lo hayu retzuotehen mekushsharot eno nizkak lahen: 
Hammotze sefer tora yoshev umeshammero umachshich alav. uvassakkana mannicho veholech lo. veim hayu geshamim yordin mitattef beor vechozer umechasse oto venichnas bo: 
Lo yetze hachayyat bemachato beyado velo hallavlar bekulmoso erev shabbat samuch lachashecha shemma yishkach veyotzi. vechayyav adam lemashmesh bevigdo erev shabbat im chashecha shemma yihye sham davar shachuach veyetze bo beshabbat. muttar latzet bitfillin erev shabbat im chashecha hoil vechayyav adam lemashmesh bitfillav bechol et eno shochchan. shachach veyatza bahen lirshut harabbim venizkar sheyyesh lo tefillin berosho mechasse et rosho ad shemmaggia leveto o levet hammidrash:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 20: Asur lehotzi massa al habbehema beshabbat shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 12)</small> "lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha" vechol behemtecha. echad shor vachamor veechad kol behema chayya vaof. veim hotzi al habbehema af al pi shehu metzuvve al shevitatah eno loke lefi sheissuro ba mikkelal ase. lefichach hamechammer achar behemto beshabbat vehaya aleha massooy patur:

Vahalo lav meforash battora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 10)</small> "lo taase chol melacha atta uvincha uvittecha veavdecha vaamatecha uvehemtecha", shello yacharosh bah vechayyotze bacharisha. venimtza lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din veen lokin alav:

Asur leyisrael lehasheil o lehasekir behema gassa lenachri shello yaase bah melacha beshabbat vahare hu metzuvve al shevitat behemto. asru chachamim limkor behema gassa lenachri shemma yashil o yaskir. veim machar konsin oto ad asara bedameha umachazirah. vaafillu shevura en mochrin. umuttar lo limkor lahem al yede sarsur shehassarsur eno maskir veeno mashil:

Umuttar limkor lahem sus sheen hassus omed ella lirchivat adam lo lemassooy vehachay nose et atzmo. uchederech sheasru limkor lenachri kach asru limkor leyisrael hechashud limkor lenachri. umuttar limkor lahem para lishchita veshochet otah befanav. velo yimkor setam afillu shor shel petam shemma yashhe oto veyaavod bo:
Makom shennahagu limkor lahen behema dakka mochrin. makom shennahagu shello limkor en mochrin. uvechol makom en mochrin lahem chayya gassa kemo sheen mochrin lahem behema gassa ella al yede sarsur:

Mi shehechshich badderech velo haya immo nachri sheyyitten lo kiso vehayta immo behema. manniach kiso aleha keshehi mehallechet ucheshettirtze laamod notlo mealeha kede shello taamod vehu aleha uchede shello tihye sham lo akira velo hannacha. veasur lo lehanehigah vaafillu bekol kol zeman shehakkis aleha kede shello yihye mechammer beshabbat. ugezerat chachamim hi shello yanniach kiso al gabbe behema ella im en immo nachri:

Haya immo cheresh shote vekatan manniach kiso al hachamor veeno notno leechad mehen mippene shehen adam miyyisrael. haya immo cheresh veshote veen immo behema notno leshote. shote vekatan notno leshote. cheresh vekatan notno lee ze mehen sheyyirtze. lo hayta immo behema velo nachri velo echad mikkol ellu mehallech bo pachot pachot mearba ammot. vaafillu metzia shebbaa leyado mehallech bah pachot pachot mearba ammot. aval kodem shettavo leyado im yachol lehacheshich aleha machshich veim lav molichah pachot pachot mearba ammot:

Muttar limshoch et habbehema bemeteg varesen shellah lirshut harabbim vehu shettihye reuya leoto haresen. kegon shir lesus veafsar legamal vachatam lenaka vesugar lechelev. aval im hotzi behema bemeteg sheen mishtammeret bo kegon shekkashar chevel befi hassus o bemeteg sheenah tzericha lo ella mishtammeret befachot mimmennu. kegon shehotzi chamor beshir shel sus o chatul besugar hare ze massooy. shekkol shemira meulla o shemira pechuta massooy hu lah:

Lo yikshor gemallim ze baze veyimshoch afillu hayu keshurin meerev shabbat enan nimshachin beshabbat. aval machnis hu chavalim letoch yado vehu shello yetze chevel mittoch yado tefach. vetzarich sheyyihye hachevel shemmippi habbehema ad yado gavoah min haaretz tefach o yoter. umippene ma lo yimshoch haggemallim hakkeshurim ze baze mippene shehu nire kemi shemmolichan leshuk shemmochrin bo habbehemot o shemmesachakin bahen sham. umippene ze lo tetze behema bezog shebbetzavvarah vaafillu haya pakuk sheen lo kol:

Lo tetze behema bezug shebbichsutah velo bechotam shebbetzavvarah velo bechotam shebbichsutah velo birtzua shebberaglah velo besullam shebbetzavvarah. veen chamor yotze bemardaat ella im ken hayta keshura lo meerev shabbat. velo yetze gamal bammetutelet hatteluya lo bedabbashto o biznavo ella im ken hayta keshura biznavo vechotarto. velo yetze haggamal akud yad velo akud regel vechen shear kol habbehemot:

En hattarnegolim yotzin bechutin velo bartzuot shebberaglehem. veen hakkevasin yotzin baagala shettachat alya shellahen. veen hakkevasot yotzot baetzim shemmannichim lahen bechatman kede sheyyitatteshu veyippelu hattolain shebbemochan. veen haegel yotze beol katan shemmannichin lo al tzavvaro kede sheyyikkana veyihye noach lacharisha. velo tetze behema bisvacha shemmannichin lah befiha kede shello tishshoch o shello tochal. lo tetze happara beor hakkuppar shemmannichin lah al daddeha kede shello yinak mimmenna hashsheretz keshehi yeshena. velo tetze bartzua shebben karneha ben lenoy ben leshammer. ez shechakak lah bekarneha yotza beafsar hakkashur bechekek beshabbat. veim techavo bizkanah asur shemma tenattechennu viviennu beyado birshut harabbim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hazzecharim yotzim baor hakkashur lahen al zachrutan kede shello yaalu al hannekevot. uvaor hakkashur lahem al libbehem kede shello yippelu alehem zeevim. uvematlaniyyot hamerukkamot shemmeyappin otan bahen. veharchelot yotzot vealya shellahen keshura lemala al gabban kede sheyyaalu alehen hazzecharim. o keshura lematta kede shello yaalu alehem hazzecharim. veyotzot meluppafot bematlaniyyot kede sheyyihye hatztzemer shellahen naki. haizzim yotzot vedaddehen keshurot kede sheyyivash mehen hechalav. aval im kesharan kede shello yetze hechalav ad sheyyachalov oto laerev hare ellu lo yetzu:

En chamor yotze beukkaf af al pi shekkashur meerev shabbat. velo yetze hassus biznav shual velo bizhorit shebben enav. velo tetze behema bikrastal shebbefiha velo besandal shebberaglah velo bekamea sheeno mumche livhema. aval yotza hi beeged sheal gav hammakka uvekaskassim sheal gabbe hashshever. uveshilya hameduldelet bah. ufokek lah zog shebbetzavvarah umetayyelet bo bechatzer. venoten lo mardaat al hachamor beshabbat umetayyel bechatzer. aval en tolin lah kerastal befiha beshabbat:

Keshem sheadam metzuvve al shevitat behemto beshabbat kach hu metzuvve al shevitat avdo vaamato veaf al pi shehen bene daat uledaat atzman osin mitzva alenu leshamran ulemanan measiyyat melacha beshabbat shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 12)</small> "lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha veyinnafesh ben amatcha vehagger". eved veama sheanu metzuvvin al shevitatan hem avadim shemmalu vetavlu leshem avdut vekibbelu mitzvot shehaavadim chayyavin bahen. aval avadim shello malu velo tavlu ella kibbelu alehen sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach bilvad hare hen keger toshav umuttarin laasot melacha beshabbat leatzman befarhesya keyisrael bechol. veen mekabbelin ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg. hoil veger toshav ose melacha leatzmo beshabbat veger tzedek hare hu keyisrael lechol davar. bemi neemar veyinnafesh ben amatcha vehagger. ze ger toshav shehu lekito usechiro shel yisrael kemo ben amato. shello yaase melacha leyisrael rabbo beshabbat aval leatzmo ose. vaafillu haya hagger ze avdo hare ze ose leatzmo:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 21:
Neemar battora <small>(Shemot 22 12)</small> <small>(Shemot 34 21)</small> "tishbot" afillu middevarim sheenan melacha chayyav lishbot mehen. udevarim harebe hen sheasru chachamim mishshum shevut. mehen devarim asurim mippene shehen domim limlachot umehen devarim asurim gezera shemma yavo mehen issur sekila. veellu hen: 
Kol hammashve gummot hare ze chayyav mishshum choresh. lefichach asur lehippanot bisde hannira beshabbat gezera shemma yashve gummot. hamefanne et haotzar beshabbat mippene shehu tzarich lo lidvar mitzva kegon sheyyachnis bo orchim o yikba bo midrash lo yigmor et kol haotzar shemma yavo lehashevot gummot. tit sheal gabbe raglo mekannecho bakkotel o bekora aval lo bakkarka shemma yavo lehashevot gummot. lo yarok bakkarka veyashuf beraglo shemma yashve gummot. umuttar lidros harok sheal gabbe karka veholech lefi tummo: 
Nashim hamesachakot beegozim ushekedim vechayyotze bahen asurot lesachek bahen beshabbat shemma yavou lehashevot gummot. veasur lechabbed et hakkarka shemma yashve gummot ella im ken haya ratzuf baavanim. umuttar lezallef mayim al gabbe hakkarka veeno choshesh shemma yashve gummot shehare eno mitkavven lechach. en sachin et hakkarka vaafillu haya ratzuf baavanim veen nofchin oto veen medichin oto afillu beyom tov kol shekken beshabbat. shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo lehashevot gummot bizman shehu ose ken bemakom sheeno ratzuf: 
Chatzer shennitkalkela bememe haggeshamim mevi teven umeradde bah. ucheshehu meradde lo yeradde lo besal velo bekuppa ella beshule hakkuppa shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo lehashevot gummot: 
Hammashke et hazzeraim chayyav mishshum zorea. lefichach asur lishov min habbor begalgal gezera shemma yemalle leginnato ulechurbato. umippene ze im haya habbor shel galgal bechatzer muttar lemalleot mimmennu baggalgal: 
Htolesh chayyav mishshum kotzer. lefichach asur lirdot devash mikkavveret beshabbat mippene shehu ketolesh. en olin beilan ben lach ben yavesh veen nitlin beilan veen nismachin beilan. velo yaale mibbeod yom leshev sham kol hayyom kullo. veen mishtammeshin bimchubbar lakkarka kelal gezera shemma yitlosh: 
Perot shennashru beshabbat asur leachlan ad motzae shabbat gezera shemma yitlosh. hadas hamechubbar muttar lehariach bo sheen hanayato ella lehariach bo vahare recho matzuy. aval etrog vetappuach vechol harauy laachila asur lehariach bo bimchubbar gezera shemma yakotz oto leachlo: 
Ilan shehayu sharashav gevohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim asur leshev alehen. veim enan gevohin shelosha hare hen kaaretz. hayu bain millemala mishshelosha letoch shelosha muttar lehishtammesh bahen. hayu gevohin shelosha af al pi shetztziddan echad shave laaretz o sheyyesh chalal tachtehen shelosha asur leshev alehen: 
En rochvin al gabbe behema beshabbat gezera shemma yachtoch zemora lehanehigah. veen nitlin bivhema velo yaale mibbeod yom leshev aleha beshabbat. veen nismachin letzidde behema. vetzidde tzedadin muttarin. ala bailan beshabbat beshogeg muttar lered. bemezid asur lered. uvivhema afillu bemezid yered mishshum tzaar baale chayyim. vechen porkin hammassooy meal habbehema beshabbat mishshum tzaar baale chayyim: 
Ketzad. hayta behemto teuna shalif shel tevua machnis rosho tachtav umesalleko letzad acher vehu nofel meelav. haya ba min hadderech belel shabbat uvehemto teuna. kesheyyaggia lechatzer hachitzona notel et hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat vesheenan nittalin mattir hachavalim vehassakkin noflin. hayu bassakkin devarim hammishtabberin. im hayu sakkin ketannim mevi karim uchesatot umanniach tachtehen vehassakkin noflin al hakkarim. shehare im yirtze lishlof hakkar sholef mippene shehassakkim ketannim vekallim venimtza shello batel hakkeli mehechano. hayta teuna ashashiyyot shel zechuchit mattir hassakkim vehen noflin sheaf al pi sheyyishshavru en bechach hefsed gadol shehare hakkol lehattacha omed ulehefsed muat lo chashshu. hayu hassakkim gedolim umeleim kele zechuchit vechayyotze bahem porek benachat. umikkol makom lo yannichan sham al gabbe behema mishshum tzaar baale chayyim: 
Hamedabbek perot ad sheyyeasu guf echad chayyav mishshum meammer. lefichach mi shennitpazzeru lo perot bachatzero melakket al yad al yad veochel. aval lo yitten lo letoch hassal velo letoch hakkuppa kederech shehu ose bechol. sheim yaase kederech shehu ose bechol shemma yichbeshem beyado betoch hakkuppa veyavo lide immur. vechen en mekabbetzin et hammelach vechayyotze bo mippene shennire kimammer: 
Mefarek chayyav mishshum dash. vehassochet zetim vaanavim chayyav mishshum mefarek. lefichach asur lischot tutim verimmonim hoil umiktzat bene adam sochatim otam kezetim vaanavim shemma yavo lischot zetim vaanavim. aval shear perot kegon perishin vetappuchim veuzeradin muttar lesochotan beshabbat mippene sheenan bene sechita: 
Kevashin ushelakot shessechatan. im lerakkech gufan muttar veim lehotzi memehen asur. veen merassekin et hashsheleg sheyyazuvu memav. aval merassek hu letoch hakkeara o letoch hakkos. hashshum vehabboser vehammelilot sherissekan mibbeod yom. im mechussarin dicha asur lo ligmor dichatan beshabbat. veim mechussarin shechika bayyad muttar lo ligmor shechikatan beshabbat. lefichach muttar ligmor shechikat harifot baetz happarur betoch hakkedera beshabbat achar shemmoridin otah meal haesh: 
Hammolel melilot molel beshinnuy kede shello yerae kedash. hayyonek befiv patur. veim haya goneach muttar lo linok befiv mippene shehu mefarek kilachar yad umishshum tzaaro lo gazru veaf al pi sheen sham sakkana: 
Perot shezzavu mehen mashkin beshabbat. im zetim vaanavim hen asur lishtot otan hammashkin ad motzae shabbat gezera shemma yitkavven veyischot otan beshabbat. veim tutim verimmonim hen. im hichnisan laachila mashkin shezzavu mehen muttarin. veim hichnisan ledarchan mashkin shezzavu mehen asurin ad motzae shabbat: 
Zetim vaanavim sherissekan meerev shabbat veyatzu mehen mashkin meatzman muttarin. vechen challot devash sherissekan meerev shabbat mashkin hayyotzin mehen beshabbat muttarin. sheen kan makom ligzera shekkevar rissekan mibbaerev: 
Zore uvorer meavot melachot hen lefichach af al pi shemmuttar limlol melilot berashe etzbeotav. keshehu menappeach menappeach beyado achat bechol kocho. aval lo bekanon velo betamchuy gezera shemma yenappe benafa uvichvara shehu chayyav. vhameshammer shemarim toledet borer o merakked hu. lefichach af al pi shemmuttar lesannen yayin tzalul o mayim tzelulin besudarin o bichfifa mitzrit. lo yaase guma bassudar shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo leshammer bimshammeret. vechen asur litlot et hameshammeret kederech shehu ose bechol shemma yavo leshammer. vechen hamechabbetz toledet borer hu. lefichach af al pi shennotnin shumshemin veegozim lidvash lo yachbetzem beyado: 
Hamechattech et hayyarak dak dak kede levashshelo hare ze toledet tochen vechayyav. lefichach en merassekin lo et hashshachat velo et hacharuvin lifne behema ben dakka ben gassa mippene shennire ketochen. aval mechattechin et haddeluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim sheen techina beferot. umattirin alummot shel amir lifne behema umefasfes beyado alummot ketannot aval lo alummot gedolot mippene hattorach shebbahen: 
Chavile pea veezov vekoranit vechayyotze bahen shehichnisan lemaachal behema mistappek mehen vekotem veochel berashe etzbeotav aval lo beyado harebe shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo laduk: 
Hatztzarich laduk pilpelim vechayyotze bahen litten letoch hammaachol beshabbat hare ze kotesh beyad hassakkin uvakkeara aval lo bemachteshet mippene shehu tochen. lefichach asur labbari lehitrappeot beshabbat gezera shemma yishchok hassammanin: 
Ketzad. lo yochal devarim sheenan maachal beriim kegon ezovyon ufea. velo devarim hameshalshelim kegon laana vechayyotze bahem. vechen lo yishte devarim sheen derech habberiim lishtotan kegon mayim shebbishshelu bahen sammanin vaasavim: 
Ochel adam ochalin umashkin shedderech habberiim leachlan velishtotan kegon hakkusbara vehakkeshut vehaezov af al pi shehen merappein veochlan kede lehitrappeot bahem muttar hoil vehem maachal beriim. shata chiltit mikkodem hashshabbat vahare hu shote veholech muttar lishtoto beshabbat [afillu] bimkomot [shello] nahagu habberiim lishtot hachiltit. veshotin zetom hammitzri bechol makom: 
Vechen shemanim shedderech habberiim lasuch bahen muttar lasuch bahen beshabbat veaf al pi shennitkavven lirfua. vesheen habberiim sachin bahen asurin. hachoshesh bematnav lo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen. velo shemen vered ella bemakom shehabberiim sachin oto. umuttar lasuch shemen umelach bechol makom. niggefa yado o raglo tzomtah beyayin veeno tzomtah bechometz. veim haya anog af beyayin asur: 
Hachoshesh beshinnav lo yigma bahen et hachometz veyiflot aval megammea hu uvolea. hachoshesh bigrono lo yearennu beshemen aval bolea hu shemen harebe veim nitrappe nitrappe. en loasin et hammastechi veen shafin et hashshinnayim besam beshabbat bizman shennitkavven lirfua. veim nitkavven lereach happe muttar: 
En notnin yayin letoch haayin aval noten hu al gav haayin. verok tafel afillu al gav haayin asur. kilor sheshshara oto meerev shabbat maaviro al gav eno beshabbat veeno choshesh. mi shellaka beetzbao lo yichroch alav gemi kede lerappeoto velo yidchakennu beyado kede lehotzi mimmennu dam: 
En notnin chammin veshemen al gabbe hammakka. velo al gabbe moch sheal gabbe hammakka. velo al gabbe moch litteno al hammakka beshabbat. aval noten hu chutz lammakka veshotet veyored lammakka. venotnin moch yavesh al gabbe hammakka. veim haya attik asur mippene shehu kirtiyya: 
Retiyya shepparsha al gabbe keli machzirin otah. veim parsha al gabbe karka asur lehachazirah. umannichin retiyya al gabbe hammakka lechattechilla bammikdash sheen issur shevut bammikdash. uvechol makom mekannechin pi hammakka veen mekannechin et hartiyya shemma yemareach: 
Sachin umemashmeshin bivne meayim beshabbat vehu sheyyasuch vimashmesh bevat achat kede shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. veen mitammelin beshabbat. e ze hu mitammel ze sheddorsim al gufo bechoach ad sheyyiga veyazzia o sheyyehallech ad sheyyiga veyazzia. sheasur leyaggea et atzmo kede sheyyazzia beshabbat mippene shehi refua. vechen asur laamod bekarka dimosit shebbeeretz yisrael mippene shemmeammelet umerappet: 
En rochatzin bemayim shemmeshalshelin velo betit shettovin bo velo beme mishra habbeushim velo beyam sedom velo bammayim haraim shebbayyam haggadol mippene shekkol ellu tzaar hen vechatuv <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vekarata lashshabbat oneg". lefichach im lo nishtaha bahem ella ala miyyad af al pi sheyyesh lo chatatin berosho muttar: 
En mitgardin bemigredet veim hayu yadav meluchlachot betzoa o betit gored kedarko veeno choshesh. sachin umefarchin leadam leanneg aval lo livhema. veim haya lah tzaar muttar lehasir tzaarah besicha uferuch. behema sheachla karshinin harebe meritzin otah bechatzer bishvil shettitrappe. veim achazah dam maamidin otah bemayim bishvil shettitztannen veen choshshin shemma yishchak lah sammanin: 
En mekiin et haochel beshabbat. bamme devarim amurim besam shemma yishchak sammanin aval lehachenis yado letoch piv ulehaki muttar. veasur lidchok kereso shel tinok kede lehotzi hari shello shemma yavo lehashekoto sammanin hameshalshelin. umuttar lichpot kos al hattabbur beshabbat kede lehaaloto. vechen muttar lechanek ulelappef et hakkatan ulehaalot aznayim ben beyad ben bichli. ulehaalot unkkeli. shekkol ellu vechayyotze bahen en osin otan besammanin kede lachush lishchika veyesh lo tzaar mehen: 
Hamerakked meavot melachot. lefichach en kovrin et hatteven bichvara velo yanniach hakkevara sheyyesh bah teven bemakom gavoah bishvil sheyyered hammotz mippene shehu kimrakked. aval notel hatteven bakkevara umolich laevus af al pi sheyyered hammotz bishat holacha shehare eno mitkavven lechach: 
Megabbel chayyav mishshum lash. lefichach en megabbelin kemach kali harebe shemma yavo lalush kemach sheeno kali. umuttar legabbel et hakkali meat meat. aval tevua shello hevia shelish shekkalu otah veachar kach tachanu otah techina gassa shehare hu kechol vehi hannikret shatit muttar legabbel mimmenna bechometz vechayyotze bo harebe bevat achat. vehu sheyyihye rach aval kashe asur mippene shennire kelash vetzarich leshannot. ketzad. noten et hashshatit veachar kach noten et hachometz: 
Hammursan af al pi sheeno rauy legibbul en govlin oto shemma yavo legabbel heafar vechayyotze bo. venotnin mayim al gabbe mursan umolich bo hattarvad sheti vaerev. aval eno memares beyado shello yerae kelash. im lo nitarev menaaro mikkeli lichli ad sheyyitarev venoten lifne hattarnegolin o lifne hashshevarim. umuttar learev hammursan al derech zo bichli echad umechallek oto bechelim harebe venoten lifne kol behema uvehema umearev bichli echad afillu kor vaafillu korayim: 
En maachilin behema chayya veof beshabbat kederech shehu maachil bechol shemma yavo lide ketishat kitniyyot o lide lishat kemach vechayyotze bo. ketzad. lo yaachil haggamal beshabbat maachal shelosha o arbaa yamim velo yarbitz egel vechayyotze bo veyiftach piv veyitten letocho karshinin umayim bevat achat. vechen lo yitten letoch pi yonim vetarnegolim lemakom sheenan yecholin lehachazir. aval maachil hu et habbehema meemmad umashke otah meummad o noten letoch piha mayim bifne atzman vecharshinin bifne atzman bemakom sheyyechola lehachazir. vechen maachil haof beyado bemakom sheyyachol lehachazir veen tzarich lomar sheyyitten lifnehen vehen ochlin: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemi shemmezonotav alav kegon behemto vechayyato veyone habbayit vaavazin vetarnegolin. aval mi sheen mezonotav alav kegon chazir veyone shovach udevorim lo yitten lifnehem lo mazon velo mayim. umuttar leadam lehaamid behemto al gabbe asavim [mechubbarim] vehi ochelet. aval lo yaamid otah al gabbe davar shehuktza aval omed befaneha kede shettachazir paneha laddavar hammuktze vetochal mimmennu. vechen beyom tov:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 22:
Rediyyat happat af al pi sheenah melacha asru otah chachamim shemma yavo leefot. hammadbik pat battannur mibbeod yom vekadash alav hayyom matztzil mimmenna mazon shalosh seuddot veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem. veaf al pi shehardiyya enah melacha keshehu matztzil lo yirde bemirde ella besakkin kede leshannot: 
Mippene ma asru chachamim likkanes bammerchatz beshabbat. mippene habballanin shehayu mechimmin chammin beshabbat veomrin meerev shabbat huchammu. lefichach gazru shello yikkanes adam lammerchatz beshabbat afillu lehazzia. vegazru shello yishtattef kol gufo bechammin vaafillu bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat. aval panav yadav veraglav muttar. bamme devarim amurim bechamme haur gezera mishshum merchatz. aval bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahen muttar lehishtattef bahen kol gufo. veasur lirchotz bemayim chammin shebbammearot mippene shehammeara yesh bah hevel veyavo lide zea venimtzet kemerchatz: 
Mitchammem adam keneged hammedura veyotze umishtattef kol gufo betzonen. aval eno mishtattef kol gufo betzonen umitchammem keneged hammedura mippene shemmafshir mayim shealav venimtza kerochetz kol gufo bechammin. hammevi silon shel tzonen betoch mayim chammin afillu betoch chamme teverya hare ellu kechammin shehuchammu beshabbat vaasurin birchitza uvishtiyya: 
Mevi adam kiton shel mayim umannicho keneged hammedura lo bishvil sheyyechammu ella kede shettafug tzinnatan. vechen manniach pach shel shemen keneged hammedura kede sheyyifshar lo sheyyecham. vesach adam yado bemayim o beshemen umechammem keneged hammedura. vehu shello yechammu hammayim sheal yado ad shettehe kereso shel tinok nichvet bahen. umechammem beged umannicho al gabbe meayim beshabbat: 
Ambeti shel merchatz shehi melea mayim chammim en notnin lah mayim tzonen shehare mechammeman harebe. vechen lo yitten letochah pach shel shemen mippene shehu kimvashshelo. aval noten hu mayim chammin letoch ambeti shel tzonen: 
Mecham sheppinna mimmennu mayim chammin muttar litten letocho mayim tzonen kede lehafeshiran. umuttar litztzok mayim chammin letoch mayim tzonen o tzonen letoch hachammin vehu shello yihyu bichli rishon mippene shehu mechammeman harebe. vechen kedera rotachat af al pi shehoridah meal haesh lo yitten letochah tavlin aval noten letochah melach shehammelach eno mitbashshel ella al gabbe esh gedola. veim yatzak hattavshil mikkedera likara af al pi shehu roteach bakkeara muttar lo litten letoch hakkeara tavlin shekkeli sheni eno mevashshel: 
En shorin et hachiltit ben befoshrin ben betzonen aval shore oto betoch hachometz. veim shatahu beyom chamishi veshishshi hare ze shore beshabbat betzonen umannicho bachamma ad sheyyecham veshote. kede shello yechele im pasak millishtot: 
Davar shenitbashshel kodem hashshabbat o nishra bechammin millifne hashshabbat af al pi shehu achshav tzonen muttar lishroto bechammin beshabbat. vedavar shehu tzonen meikkaro velo ba bechammin meolam medichin oto bechammin beshabbat im lo hayta hadachato gemar melachto aval en shorin oto bechammin: 
Muttar lehachem bachamma af al pi sheasur lehachem betoldot chamma sheeno ba litot mechamma leur. lefichach muttar litten mayim tzonen bashshemesh kede sheyyechammu. vechen notnin mayim yafim letoch mayim raim bishvil sheyyetzannu. venotnin tavshil letoch habbor bishvil sheyyehe shamur: 
Mearev adam mayim umelach veshemen vetovel bo pitto o notno letoch hattavshil. vehu sheyyaase meat aval harebe asur mippene shennire keose melacha mimmelechet hattavshil. vechen lo yaase me melach azzin vehen shene shelishe melach ushelish mayim mippene shennire keose mureyas. umuttar limloach betza aval tzenon vechayyotze bo asur mippene shennire kechovesh kevashim beshabbat vehakkovesh asur mippene shehu kimvashshel. umuttar litbol tzenon vechayyotze bo bemelach veochel: 
Muttar learev yayin udevash ufilpelin beshabbat leachlan aval yayin umayim veshemen afarsemon asur sheen ze rauy laachilat beriim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Chardal shellasho meerev shabbat lemachar memacho ben beyad ben bichli venoten letocho devash velo yitrof ella mearev. shachalayim shetterafan meerev shabbat lemachar noten letocho shemen vechometz vetavlin velo yitrof ella mearev. shum sherisseko meerev shabbat lemachar notno letoch haggerisin velo yishchok ella mearev: 
Hannotel sear migguf haadam chayyav mishshum gozez. lefichach asur lirchotz et hayyadayim bidvar shemmashshir et hassear vadday kegon ohola vechayyotze bo. umuttar lachof et hayyadayim baafar levona vaafar pilpelin vaafar yasmin vechayyotze bahen veeno choshesh shemma yashshir sear sheal yado shehare eno mitkavven. erev davar shemmashshir et hassear vadday im davar sheeno mashshir vadday im haya harov middavar hammashshir asur lachof bo veim lav muttar: 
Asur lirot bemara shel mattechet beshabbat gezera shemma yashshir bah nimin hameduldalin min hassear vaafillu kavua bakkotel. aval mara sheenah shel mattechet muttar lirot bah afillu enah kevua: 
Hamechabbes chayyav mishshum melabben. vehassochet kesut chayyav mippene shehu mechabbes. lefichach asur lidchok matlit o moch vechayyotze bahen befi haashisha vechayyotze bah kede lesatmah shemma yavo lide sechita. veen mekannechin bisfog ella im ken yesh lo bet achiza shello yischot. veen mechassin chavit shel mayim vechayyotze bah beveged sheeno muchan lah gezera shemma yischot: 
Nishbera lo chavit beshabbat matztzil mimmenna ma shehu tzarich leshabbat lo uleorchav uvilvad shello yispog beyayin o yetappach beshemen sheim yaase kederech shehu ose bechol shemma yavo lide sechita. vechetzad matztzil mimmenna. mevi keli umanniach tachteha. velo yavi keli acher veyiklot keli acher vitzaref gezera shemma yavi keli derech reshut harabbim. nizdammenu lo orchim mevi keli acher vekolet keli acher umetzarfo larishon. velo yiklot veachar kach yazmin ella yazmin veachar kach yiklot. veim heerim bedavar ze muttar: 
Tit sheal gabbe bigdo mechaskeso mibbifnim veeno mechaskeso mibbachutz gezera shemma yechabbes. umuttar legardo betzipporen veeno choshesh shemma yelabbeno. hamechaskes et hassudar asur mippene shehu melabbeno aval hechaluk muttar mippene sheen kavvanato ella lerakkecho: 
Minal o sandal shennitlachlech betit uvetzoa muttar leshachshecho bemayim aval lechabbeso asur. veen megardin lo minalim velo sandalim chadashim aval sachin (otam) umekannechin et hayeshanim. kar o keset shehaya alehen tzoa o tinnuf mekannecho bismartut. veim hayta al shel or notnin aleha mayim ad shettichle: 
Mi shennitlachlecha yado betit mekannechah biznav hassus uviznav happara uvemappa hakkasha haasuya leechoz bah hakkotzim. aval lo bemappa shemmekannechin bah et hayyadayim shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo lechabbes et hammappa: 
Mi sherachatz bemayim mistappeg baaluntito umeviah beyado veen choshshin shemma yischot. vechen mi shennashru kelav bemayim mehallech bahen veen choshshin shemma yischot. veasur lo leshatchan vaafillu betoch beto gezera shemma yomar haroe hare ze kibbes kesuto beshabbat ushetachah leyabbeshah. vechol makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin afillu bechadre chadarim asur: 
Shete metahrot zo al gav zo notel et happekak mibbentayim umeshikan umachazir et happekak limkomo mippene sheeno ba lide sechita shehare dato sheyyetzu hammayim. ufokkin et habbiv besudarin uvechol davar hammittaltel kede shello yatzufu hammayim al hoochalim veal hakkelim. aval en pokkin et habbiv kede sheyyerdu hammayim labbor shemma yischot beet sheddochek shehare happekak sharuy bemayim: 
Asur letakken bet yad shel begadim uleshabberam shevarim shevarim kederech shemmetakkenin bechol habbegadim keshemmechabbesin otan. vechen en mekappelim habbegadim beshabbat kederech sheosin bechol babbegadim kesheyyechabbesu otan. veim lo haya lo keli acher lehachalifo muttar lekappelo ulefashto ulehitkassot bo kede sheyyitnae bo beshabbat. vehu sheyyihye beged chadash lavan shehare hu mitmaech umitlachlech miyyad. uchesheyyekappel lo yekappel ella ish echad aval lekappel bishnayim asur: 
Hatztzovea meavot melachot lefichach asur leishsha lehaavir serak al paneha mippene shehi ketzovaat. vehattofer meavot melachot lefichach asur lemalleot hakkar vehakkeset hachadashim bemochin gezera shemma yitpor. aval mochin shennashru min hakkar o min hakkeset machzirin otan beshabbat: 
Hakkorea meavot melachot. lefichach mi shennistabbechu begadav bekotzim mafrishan betzina umitmahmeah kede shello yikra. veim nikreu eno chayyav kelum shehare lo nitkavvin. umuttar lilbosh begadim chadashim veim nikreu nikreu. potzin et haegoz bematlit veen choshshin shemma tikkara: 
Hattokea chayyav mishshum bone. lefichach kol haddelatot hamechubbarot lakkarka lo notlin otan velo machzirin gezera shemma yitka. aval delet shidda teva umigdal ushear daltot hakkelim notlin velo machzirin. veim nishmat tzir hattachton shellahen dochakin oto limkomo. uvammikdash machzirin oto. aval tzir haelyon shennishmat asur lehachaziro bechol makom gezera shemma yitka: 
En godlin et sear harosh veen poksin oto mippene shennire kevone. veen machzirin menora shel chulyot velo kisse hamefutztzal velo shulchan hamefutztzal vechayyotze bahen mippene shennire kevone. veim hechezir patur sheen binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim. veim haya rafuy muttar lehachaziro. veen metakkenin chulyot shel shidra shel katan zo betzad zo mippene shennire kevone: 
Haose ohel kavua chayyav mishshum bone. lefichach en osin ohel aray lechattechilla velo sotrin ohel aray gezera shemma yaase o yistor ohel kavua. veim asa o satar ohel aray patur. umuttar lehosif al ohel aray beshabbat. ketzad. tallit shehayta perusa al haammudim o al hakketalim vehayta kerucha kodem hashshabbat im nishar mimmenna gag tefach matuach hare ze moteach et kullah beshabbat ad sheyyaase ohel gadol. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En tolin et hakkilla shehare naaset tachteha ohel aray. umuttar lehanniach mitta vechisse uteraskal veaf al pi sheyyease tachtehen ohel sheen ze derech asiyyat ohel lo keva velo aray: 
Kol ohel meshuppa sheen begaggo tefach velo befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggo rochav tefach hare ze ohel aray vehaose oto lechattechilla beshabbat patur. tallit kefula shehayu aleha chutin shehi teluya bahen meerev shabbat muttar lintotah umuttar lefarkah vechen happarochet: 
Killat chatanim sheen begaggah tefach veen befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggah rochav tefach. hoil shehi metukkenet lechach muttar lintotah umuttar lefarkah vehu shello tehe meshulshelet meal hammitta tefach. pekak hachallon bizman shehu metukkan lechach af al pi sheeno kashur veeno taluy muttar lifkok bo hachallon: 
Kova sheosin al harosh veyesh lo safa makkefet shehi osa tzel kemo ohel al levusho muttar lelavsho. veim hotzi min habbeged saviv lerosho o keneged panav kemo ohel vehaya mehuddak al rosho vehayta hassafa shehotziah kasha beyoter kemo gag asur mippene shehu ose ohel aray: 
Hannote parochet vechayyotze bah tzarich lehizzaher shello yaase ohel beshaa shennote lefichach im hayta parochet gedola tolin otah shenayim aval echad asur. veim hayta killa sheyyesh lah gag en motchin otah vaafillu asara shei efshar shello tigba meat meal haaretz vetease ohel aray: 
Beged shemmechasse bo pi hechavit lo yechasse bo et kullah mippene shennaasa ohel aval mechasse hu miktzat piha. hamesannen bichfifa mitzrit lo yagbiah karkait hakkefifa min hakkeli tefach kede shello yaase ohel aray beshabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 23: Haose nekev shehu asuy lehachenis ulehotzi kegon nekev shebbelul hattarnegolin shehu asuy lehachenis haora ulehotzi hahevel hare ze chayyav mishshum makke befattish. lefichach gazru al kol nekev afillu haya asuy lehotzi bilvad o lehachenis bilvad shemma yavo laasot nekev shechayyavin alav. umippene ze en nokvin bechavit nekev chadash veen mosifin bo. aval potchin nekev yashan. vehu shello yihye hannekev lematta min hashshemarim sheim haya lematta min hashshemarim hare ze asuy lechazzek veasur lefatcho:

Nokvin megufa shel chavit lehotzi mimmenna yayin uvilvad sheyyenakkevennah millemala aval mitztziddah asur mippene shehu kimtakken keli. shover adam et hechavit leechol mimmenna gerogarot uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot keli. umevi adam chavit shel yayin umattiz et roshah besayif lifne haorchin veeno choshesh. sheen kavvanato ella lehareot nedivat libbo:

Ucheshem sheasur liftoach kol nekev kach asur listom kol nekev. lefichach asur listom nekev hechavit vaafillu bedavar sheeno mitmareach veeno ba lide sechita kegon sheyyistom bekesam o bitzror katan. aval im hinniach sham ochel kede lehatzenio venimtza hannekev nistam muttar. umuttar lehaarim bedavar ze:

Kol davar shehu gemar melacha chayyav alav mishshum makke befattish. umippene ze haggorer kol shehu o hametakken keli beeze davar sheyyetakken chayyav. lefichach asur lehashemia kol shel shir beshabbat ben bichle shir kegon kinnorot unevalim ben bishar devarim. afillu lehakkot beetzba al hakkarka o al halluach o achat keneged achat kederech hameshorrim o lekashkesh et haegoz letinok o lesachek bo bezog kede sheyyishtok kol ze vechayyotze bo asur gezera shemma yetakken kele shir:

En mesappekin velo merakkedin veen metappechin beshabbat gezera shemma yetakken kele shir. ulesappek kilachar yad muttar. en shatin al pene hammayim gezera shemma yetakken chavit shel shayyatin. berecha shebbechatzer muttar lashut betochah sheeno ba laasot chavit shel shayyatin vehu sheyyihye lah safa mukkefet shello yeaker mimmenna hammayim. kede sheyyihye hekker vehefresh benah uven hayyam:

En chotchin shefoferet shel kane mippene shehu kimtakken keli. hayta chatucha af al pi sheenah metukkenet muttar lehachenisah benekev hechavit beshabbat lehotzi mimmenna yayin veen choshshin shemma yetakken. veasur lehanniach ale shel hadas vechayyotze bo betoch hannekev shel chavit kede sheyyekalleach et hayyayin mippene shehu keose marzev beshabbat. veen shovrin et hacheres veen korin et hanneyar mippene shehu kimtakken keli:

Zemora shehi keshura betafiach memallein bah beshabbat. veim enah keshura en memallein bah gezera shemma yiktom otah veyitkaah. asur lachof kele kesef begartakon mippene shehu melabbenan kederech shehaummanin osin venimtza kimtakken keli vegomer melachto beshabbat. aval choffin oto bechol uveneter. vechen kol hakkelim choffin otan bechol davar. veasur lehadiach kearot veilpasin vechayyotze bahen mippene shehu kimtakken ella im ken hedichan leechol bahen seudda acheret beotah shabbat. aval kele shetiyya kegon kosot vekitonot muttar lahadichan bechol et sheen keva lishtiyya. veen matztziin et hammittot beshabbat kede lishon alehen lemotzae shabbat aval matztziin millele shabbat leshabbat:

Asur lehatebil kelim temein beshabbat mippene shehu kimtakken keli. aval adam tame muttar litbol mippene shennire kemeker. veen mazzin alav beshabbat. hammatbil kelim beshabbat beshogeg yishtammesh bahen. bemezid lo yishtammesh bahen ad lemotzae shabbat. umuttar lehatebil et hammayim hattemeim beshabbat. ketzad yaase. notnan bichli sheeno mekabbel tuma kegon kele avanim umatbil hakkelim bammikve ad sheyyaale me hammikve alehen veyitharu:
En magbihin terumot umaasrot beshabbat mippene shennire kimtakken davar shello haya metukkan:

Meabbed meavot melachot hu. vehamerakkech or beshemen kederech shehaabbedanim osim hare ze meabbed vechayyav. lefichach lo yasuch adam raglo beshemen vehu betoch hamminal o betoch hassandal hachadashim. aval sach hu et raglo shemen velovesh minalo o sandalo af al pi shehen chadashim. vesach kol gufo shemen umitaggel al gabbe kattavliya chadasha veeno choshesh. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hashshemen muat kede sheyyetzachtzeach haor bilvad aval im haya bivsaro shemen harebe kede sheyyerakkech haor hare ze asur mippene shehu kimabbedo. vehakkol bachadashim aval bishanim muttar:
Hamemareach retiyya beshabbat chayyav mishshum mochek et haor. lefichach en sotmin nekev beshaava vechayyotze bah shemma yemareach vaafillu beshumman en sotmin et hannekev gezera mishshum shaava:

Kotev meavot melachot. lefichach asur lichchol bappuch vechayyotze bo beshabbat mippene shehu kechotev. veasur lilvot ulehalvot gezera shemma yichtov. vechen asur liknot velimkor veliskor ulehaskir gezera shemma yichtov. lo yiskor adam poalim beshabbat velo yomar lachavero liskor lo poalin. aval lishl ulehashil muttar. shoel adam mechavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen uvilvad shello yeamer lo haleveni:
Echad hammocher bappe o bimsira asur. [veasur lishkol] ben bemoznayim ben shello bemoznayim. ucheshem sheasur lishkol kach asur limnot velimdod ben bichli midda ben bayyad ben bechevel:

En danin beshabbat velo choltzin velo meyabbemin velo mekaddeshin gezera shemma yichtov. veen makdishin velo maarichin velo machrimin mippene shehu kemikkach umimkar. veen magbihin terumot umaasrot shezze dome lemakdish otan perot shehifrish. veod mippene shehu kimtakken otan beshabbat. veen measserin et habbehema gezera shemma yirshom besikra. umakdish adam pischo beshabbat vachagigato beyom tov shezzo mitzvat hayyom hi. ucheshem sheen makdishin kach en mekaddeshin me chattat:

Hammagbiah terumot umaasrot beshabbat o beyom tov beshogeg yochal mimma shehitkin. bemezid lo yochal ad motzae shabbat. uven kach uven kach tikken et happerot. vechen hammakdish o hammaarich o hammacharim beshabbat ben beshogeg ben bemezid ma sheasa asuy veen tzarich lomar beyom tov. vechen hammakne lachavero beshabbat kana. measserin et haddemay ben hashshemashot aval lo et havvadday:

Mi shekkara shem litrumat maaser shel demay o lemaasar ani shel vadday lo yitlem beshabbat af al pi sheyyeyached mekoman mikkodem hashshabbat vahare hen yeduin umunnachin betzad happerot. veim haya kohen o ani lemudim leechol etzlo yavou veyochlu. uvilvad sheyyodia lakkohen shezzo sheani maachilcha terumat maaser veyodia leani shezzo sheani maachilcha maasar ani:
Asur lehafis ulesachek bekubbiyya beshabbat mippene shehu kemikkach umimkar. umefis adam im banav veim bene beto al mana gedola keneged mana ketanna mippene sheen makpidin:

Asur lechashshev cheshbonot shehu tzarich lahen beshabbat ben sheavar ben sheatid lihyot gezera shemma yichtov. lefichach cheshbonot sheen bahen tzorech muttar lechashshevan. ketzad. kamma sein tevua haya lanu beshana pelonit, kamma dinarin hotzi bechatnut beno, vechayyotze beellu shehen bichlal sicha betela sheen bahen tzorech kelal, hamechashshev otan beshabbat kimchashshev bechol:

Asur likrot beshitre hedyotot beshabbat shello yehe kederech chol veyavo limchok. mone adam parperotav veet orchav mippiv aval lo min hakketav kede shello yikra beshitre hedyotot. lefichach im hayu hashshemot chakukin al hattavla o al hakkotel muttar likrotan mippene sheeno mitchallef bishtar. veasur likrot bichtav hamehallech tachat hatztzura vetachat haddeyukeni beshabbat. af likrot bakketuvim beshabbat bishat bet hammidrash asur gezera mishshum bittul bet hammidrash shello yihye kol echad yoshev beveto vekore veyimmana mibbet hammidrash:

Nafla deleka bechatzer beshabbat eno matztzil kol ma sheyyesh bechatzer lechatzer acheret shebbeoto hammavoy af al pi sheervu gezera shemma yechabbe haddeleka kede sheyyatztzil mippene sheadam bahul al mamono. lefichach gazru shello yatztzil ella mazon shehu tzarich lo leoto shabbat vechelim shetztzarich lehishtammesh bahen beshabbat uvegadim sheyyachol lilbosh. shennimtza mityaesh min hakkol veeno ba lide kibbuy. veim lo ervu af mezono vechelav eno matztzil:

Uma hu matztzil limzono. im nafla deleka belele shabbat matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot. harauy leadam leadam veharauy livhema livhema. nafla beshacharit matztzilin mezon shete seuddot. bemincha matztzilin mezon seudda achat:

Bamme devarim amurim bematztzil bechelim harebe o shehaya memalle keli umotzio umeare vechozer umemalle oto shenit hu sheen matztzil ella ma shehu tzarich lo. aval im hotzi keli echad behotzaa achat af al pi sheyyesh bo kamma seuddot muttar:

Ketzad. matztzil sal male kikkarot af al pi sheyyesh bo kamma seuddot. veiggul shel devela vechavit shel yayin. vechen im paras tallito vekibbetz bah kol ma sheyyachol lehotzi vehotziah melea bevat achat muttar:

Veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem vechol echad veechad matztzil mazon shehu tzarich lo o keli echad shemmachazik afillu davar gadol vahare hu shel matztzil. veim lo ratza hammatztzil lekachto unetano livalav muttar lo littol mimmennu achar hashshabbat sechar amalo veen ze sechar shabbat shehare en sham melacha velo issur shello hotzio ella bemakom meorav:

Hitztzil pat nekiyya eno chozer umatztzil pat sheenah nekiyya. aval im hitztzil pat sheenah nekiyya chozer umatztzil pat nekiyya. umatztzil beyom hakkippurim ma shehu tzarich leshabbat im haya yom hakkippurim beerev shabbat aval eno matztzil beshabbat leyom hakkippurim. veen tzarich lomar leyom tov. velo mishshabbat zo leshabbat habbaa. uma shehu matztzil lilbosh. lovesh kol ma shehu yachol lilbosh veotef kol ma shehu yachol laatof umotzi veomer laacherim bou vehatztzilu lachem. vechol echad veechad lovesh umitattef bechelav umotzi. vahare hu shello kemo hammaachol shehare min hahefker hen zochin:

Muttar lehatztzil kol kitve hakkodesh sheyyesh bechatzer lechatzer acheret shebbeoto hammavoy veaf al pi shello ervu. uvilvad sheyyihye lammavoy shalosh mechitztzot velechi echad. vehu sheyyihyu ketuvin ashshurit uvilshon hakkodesh aval im haya ketuvin bechol lashon o bichtav acher en matztzilin otan afillu haya sham eruv. uvechol asur likrot bahem ella mannichan bimkom hattoref vehen mitabbedin mealehen:

Hayu ketuvin besam uvesikra af al pi sheeno ketav shel kayyama hoil vehen ketuvin ashshurit uvilshon kodesh matztzilin otan. gillayon shel sefarim shellemala veshellematta veshebben parasha lefarasha veshebben daf ledaf veshebbitchillat hassefer veshebbesof hassefer en matztzilin otan. habberachot vehakkemein af al pi sheyyesh bahen otiyyot shel shem umeinyanot harebe shel tora en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka:

Sefer tora sheyyesh bo lelakket shemonim vechamesh otiyyot mittoch tevot shelemot vaafillu bichlalan <small>(Bereshit lo 47)</small> "yegar sahaduta". vechen im hayta bah parasha sheen bah shemonim vechamesh otiyyot veyesh bah hazekarot kegon <small>(Bamidbar 10 la)</small> "vayhi binsoa haaron". matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka. umatztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer vetik tefillin im hattefillin af al pi sheyyesh betochan maot:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 24: Yesh devarim shehen asurin beshabbat af al pi sheenam domin limlacha veenam meviin lide melacha. umippene ma neesru mishshum shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beyom kadshi" veneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vechibbadto measot derachecha mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar". lefichach asur leadam lehallech bachafatzav beshabbat vaafillu ledabber bahen kegon sheyyedabber im shuttafo ma yimkor lemachar o ma yikne o heach yivne bayit ze uvee ze sechora yelech lemakom peloni. kol ze vechayyotze bo asur shenneemar vedabber davar dibbur asur hirhur muttar:

Asur leadam lifkod ginnotav usedotav beshabbat kede lirot ma hen tzerichin o heach hen perotehen. shehare ze mehallech laasot cheftzo. vechen asur leadam sheyyetze beshabbat ad sof hattechum veyeshev sham ad shettechshach kede sheyyihye karov laasot chafatzav bemotzae shabbat. shehare nimtza hillucho beshabbat laasot chafatzav:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehechshich al hattechum laasot davar sheasur beshabbat laasoto. aval im hechshich laasot davar shemmuttar laasoto beshabbat hare ze muttar. ketzad. en machshichin al hattechum lehavi perot mechubbarin o liskor poalin. aval machshich hu lishmor perot shehare muttar lishmor beshabbat. umachshich lehavi behema o perot telushin. shehabbehema kore lah vehi baa af al pi shehi chutz lattechum. uferot telushin illu hayu sham mechitztzot haya muttar lahavian beshabbat. vechen omer adam lachavero lichrach peloni ani holech lemachar sheim hayu sham bureganim haya holech lesham beshabbat. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Muttar leadam lomar lefoel hannire shettaamod immi laerev. aval lo yomar lo heye nachon li laerev shennimtza ose cheftzo beshabbat. veasur larutz uledalleg beshabbat shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "measot derachecha" shello yehe hilluchecha shel shabbat kehilluchecha shel chol. veyored adam levor veshiach umeara afillu hen mea amma umetappes veyored veshote umetappes veole. veasur leharebot besicha betela shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vedabber davar" shello yehe dibburecha shel shabbat kedibburecha shel chal:

Muttar larutz beshabbat lidvar mitzva kegon sheyyarutz levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash. umechashshevin cheshbonot shel mitzva umoddin medida shel mitzva kegon mikve leda im yesh kashshiur o beged leda im mekabbel tuma. ufoskin tzedaka laaniyyim. veholchin levatte kenesiyyot ulevatte midrashot vaafillu letarteot uteraklin shel kutim lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat. umeshaddechin al hattinoket leares veal hattinok lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ummanut. umevakkerin cholin umenachamim avelim. vehannichnas levakker et hachole omer shabbat hi millizok urefua kerova lavo. umachshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske kalla veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin. veomer lo lech lemakom peloni lo matzata sham have mimmakom peloni lo matzata bemane have bematayim. uvilvad shello yizkor lo sechum mikkach. shekkol ellu vechayyotze bahen mitzva hen veneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "asot chafatzecha" vechulei chafatzecha asurin cheftze shamayim muttarin:

Mafligin bayyam haggadol beerev shabbat lidvar mitzva ufosek immo lishbot veeno shovet. umefirin nedarim beshabbat ben letzorech shabbat ben shello letzorech shabbat. venishalin lechacham al hannedarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat umattirin af al pi shehaya lahen penay lehattiran kodem hashshabbat sheddevarim ellu mitzva hen:

En onshin beshabbat af al pi shehaonesh mitzvat ase enah docha shabbat. ketzad. hare shennitchayyev bevet din malkot o mita en malkin oto veen memitin oto beshabbat shenneemar <small>(Shemot la 3)</small> "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat" zo azhara levet din shello yisrefu beshabbat mi shennitchayyev serefa vehu haddin lishar onashin:

Muttar leadam lishmor perotav beshabbat ben telushim ben mechubbarin. veim ba adam littol mehen o behema vechayya leechol mehen goer bahen umakke bahem umarchikan. vahalo davar ze mechafatzav hu velamma hu muttar. mippene shello neesar ella lehakenot leatzmo chafatzim sheenan atta metzuyim o lehistakker uleharviach ulehittafel bahanaa shettavo leyado. aval lishmor mamono shekkevar ba leyado ad sheyyaamod kemot shehu muttar. ha lema ze dome lenoel beto mippene haggannavim:
Hameshammer zeraav mippene haofot umikshaav umidlaav mippene hachayya lo yesappek velo yerakked kederech sheose bechol gezera shemma yittol tzeror veyizrok arba ammot birshut harabbim:

Kol haddevarim shehen asurin mishshum shevut lo gazru alehen ben hashshemashot ella beatzmo shel yom hu shehen asurin aval ben hashshemashot muttarin. vehu sheyyihye sham devar mitzva o dochak. ketzad. muttar lo ben hashshemashot laalot bailan o lashut al pene hammayim lehavi lulav o shofar. vechen morid min hailan o motzi min hakkarmelit eruv sheasa. vechen im haya tarud venechpaz venitzrach ledavar shehu mishshum shevut ben hashshemashot hare ze muttar. aval im lo haya sham dochak velo devar mitzva asur. lefichach en measserin et havvadday ben hashshemashot af al pi sheissur haferashat hammaaser beshabbat mishshum shevut. aval measserim et haddemay:
Katan sheasa beshabbat davar shehu mishshum shevut kegon shettalash meatzitz sheeno nakuv o tiltel becharmelit en bet din metzuvvin lehaferisho. vechen im hinnicho aviv en memachin beyado:

Asru chachamim letaltel miktzat devarim beshabbat kederech shehu ose bechol. umippene ma nagu beissur ze. amru uma im hizhiru neviim vetziuu shello yihye hilluchecha beshabbat kehilluchecha bechol velo sichat hashshabbat kesichat hchol shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vedabber davar" kal vachomer shello yihye tiltul beshabbat ketiltul bechol kede shello yihye keyom chol beenav veyavo lehagebiah uletakken kelim mippinna lefinna o mibbayit levayit o lehatzenia avanim vechayyotze bahen shehare hu batel veyoshev beveto vivakkesh davar sheyyitassek bo venimtza shello shavat uvittel hattaam shenneemar betora <small>(Shemot 22 12)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 13)</small> "lemaan yanuach":

Veod kesheyyevakker vitaltel kelim shemmelachtan leissur efshar sheyyitassek bahen meat veyavo lide melacha. veod mippene shemmiktzat haam enam baale ummanuyyot ella betelin kol yemehen kegon hattayyalin veyoshve keranot shekkol yemehen hen shovtim mimmelacha veim yihye muttar lehallech uledabber uletaltel kishar hayyamim nimtza shello shavat shevita hannikkeret. lefichach shevita middevarim ellu hi shevita hashshava bechol adam. umippene devarim ellu nagu beissur hattiltul. veasru shello yetaltel adam beshabbat ella kelim hatztzarich lahem kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 25: Yesh keli shemmelachto lehetter vehu hakkeli shemmuttar laasot bo beshabbat davar shennaasa lo bechol. kegon kos lishtot bo ukeara leechol bah vesakkin lachtoch bo basar ufat vekurnas liftzoa bo egozim vechayyotze bahen:
Veyesh keli shemmelachto leissur vehu hakkeli sheasur laasot bo beshabbat davar shennaasa bo. kegon machteshet verechayim vechayyotze bahen sheasur lichtosh velitchon beshabbat:

Kol keli shemmelachto lehetter ben haya shel etz o shel cheres o shel even o shel mattechet muttar letaltelo beshabbat. ben bishvil atzmo shel keli ben letzorech mekomo ben letzorech gufo. vechol keli shemmelachto leissur ben haya shel etz o shel cheres o shel avanim o shel mattechet muttar letaltelo beshabbat ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo aval bishvil atzmo shel keli asur:

Ketzad. metaltel hu et hakkeara shel etz leechol bah o leshev bimkomah. o kede shello tigganev. veze hu bishvil atzmah. vechen im tiltel otah min hachamma kede shello tityabbesh vetishshaver o min haggeshamim kede shello titpach vetippased hare ze metaltel bishvil atzmah umuttar mippene shemmelachtah lehetter:

Vechen metaltel hu harechayim o hammachteshet leshabber aleha egozim o laalot aleha lammitta veze hu letzorech gufo o leshev bimkomo. aval eno metaltelah kede shello tishshaver velo kede shello tigganev. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Vechol sheeno keli kegon avanim umaot vekanim vekorot vechayyotze bahen asur letaltelan. even gedola o kora gedola af al pi shehi nittelet baasara bene adam im yesh torat keli aleha metaltelim otah. daltot habbayit af al pi shehen kelim lo huchenu letaltel lefichach im nitparku afillu beshabbat en metaltelin otan. vechen heafar vehachol vehammet en mezizin otan mimmekoman. uven shemona chay hare hu keeven veasur letaltelo:

Muttar letaltel hakkeli afillu shello letzorech tashmisho ella laasot bo melacha shello naasa letashmishah. ketzad. notel adam kurnas liftzoa bo egozim. kordom lachtoch bo devela. megera legarer bah et haggevina. magrefa ligrof bah et haggerogarot. et harachat veet hammazleg latet alav ochel lekatan. et hakkosh veet hakkarkar litchov bo. machat shel sakkain liftoach bo et haddelet. et hammachteshet leshev aleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Umetaltel adam machat shel yad hashshelema littol bah et hakkotz. aval im nittal hakkatze hannakuv shellah o hakkatze hachad shellah en metaltelin otah. veim hayta golem vaadayin lo nikkeva muttar letaltelah:

Kol keli shemmakpid alav shemma yifchatu damav kegon kelim hammuktzim lischora vechelim hayekarim beyoter shemmakpid alehen shemma yippasdu asur letaltelan beshabbat veze hu hannikra muktze mechamat chesron kis. kegon hammassar haggadol veyated shel machresha vesakkin shel tabbachim vecherev shel ushekafim vechitztzin hacharashim vekurnas shel bassamim vechayyotze bahen:

Kol keli shehuktza mechamat haissur asur letaltelo. kegon ner shehidliku bo beshabbat vehammenora shehaya hanner aleha veshulchan shehayu alav maot af al pi shekkava hanner o shennaflu hammaot asur letaltelan. shekkol keli shehaya asur letaltelo ben hashshemashot neesar letaltelo kol hashshabbat kullah af al pi shehalach haddavar sheggaram lo haissur:
Aval keli hammuktze mechamat meuso kegon ner yashan shel neft ucheli hatztzoa vechayyotze bahen muttar letaltelan beshabbat im hutzrach lahen:

Kol hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat shennitparku daltotehen kegon daltot shidda teva umigdal ben shennitparku beshabbat ben shennitparku kodem hashshabbat muttar letaltel otan delatot. vechen kol hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat shennishberu ben kodem hashshabbat ben beshabbat shivrehen nittalin vehu sheyyihyu shivrehen osin meen melachtan. ketzad. shivre areva lechassot bahen et pi hechavit. shivre zechuchit lechassot bahen et pi happach. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval im en hashshevarim reuyin limlacha kelal asur letaltelan:

Kol kissuye hakkelim nittalim beshabbat vehu sheyyesh torat keli alehen. haya keli mechubbar bakkarka kegon chavit hattemuna baaretz. im yesh bakkissuy shellah bet achiza metaltelin oto veim lav en metaltelin oto. vechen kissuye hakkarkaot kegon borot vacharitzin en metaltelin kissuy shellahen ella im ken yesh lo bet achiza. kissuy hattannur af al pi sheen lo bet achiza muttar letaltelo:

Shene devarim echad asur letaltelo veechad muttar letaltelo vehen semuchim ze laze o ze al ze o ze baze uvizman shemmetaltelin echad mehen yetaltel hashsheni. im haya tzarich laddavar shemmuttar letaltelo metaltelo veaf al pi sheddavar haasur mittaltel immo. veim tzarich letaltel davar haasur lo yetaltelennu beoto davar hammuttar:

Ketzad. pagga shehayta temuna beteven vacharara shehayta al gabbe gechalim tochavan bechosh o becharkar venotlan veaf al pi shehatteven vehaggechalim ninarim beshabbat bishat netila. vechen lefet o tzenonot shehayu temunim beafar umiktzat healim megullim shomtan beshabbat beale shellahen veaf al pi sheheafar ninar. aval im haya kikkar o tinok al gabbe haeven o al gabbe hakkora lo yetaltel haeven o hakkora bakkikkar o battinok sheyyesh aleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Notel adam et beno sheyyesh lo gaguin alav vehaeven beyado aval lo dinar sheim yippol haddinar yittelennu haav beyado. kalkala shehayta nekuva vesatam nekev shellah beeven muttar letaltelah shehare haeven naaset kedofen. hayta hakkalkala melea perot vehaeven betoch happerot im hayu happerot retubbim kegon anavim vetutim notel otah kemot shehi sheim yenaer happerot yittanfu beafar uvimkom hefsed lo gazru:

Chavit sheshshachach even al piha mattah al tziddah vehi nofelet. hayta ben hechaviyyot vehaeven aleha magbihah lemakom acher umatte al tziddah sham vehaeven nofelet. vechen hashshocheach maot al hakkar vetzarach lakkar noer et hakkar vehen noflot. veim tzarich limkom hakkar notel et hakkar vehammaot alav. aval im hinniach hammaot meerev shabbat al hakkar o hinniach haeven al pi hechavit hare ellu asurin letaltelan vaafillu nittelu hammaot vehaeven shehare naasu basis ledavar haasur:
Haeven shebbakkeruya im memallein bah veenah nofelet hare hi kemiktzat hakkeruya umuttar lemalleot bah veim lav en memallein bah. beged sheal hakkane shomto meal hakkane:

Perot sheasur leechol kegon perot sheenam meessarin afillu hen chayyavin bemaaser middivrehem o maaser rishon shello nittela terumato o teruma temea o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kehilchatan asur letaltelan. aval haddemay hoil verauy laaniyyim vechen maaser sheni vehekdesh sheppedaan af al pi shello natan hachomesh muttar letaltelan:

Metaltel yisrael hatteruma af al pi sheenah reuya lo. umetaltelin teruma temea im hattehora o im hachullin im hayu shenehem bichli echad. bamme devarim amurim beshehayta hattehora lematta vehayu perot hammittannefin bakkarka sheim yenaer otan yippasdu. aval im hayu egozim ushekedim vechayyotze bahen noer hakkeli venotel hattehora o hachullin umanniach hattuma. veim haya tzarich limkom hakkeli ben shehattehora lemala ben shehayta lematta metaltel hakkol keechad:

Nidbach shel avanim shechashav alav mibbeod yom im limdum muttar leshev alehen lemachar veim lav asur. charayot shel dekel sheggedaran leetzim venimlach alehen meerev shabbat lishiva muttar letaltelan. vechen im yashav alehen mibbeod yom muttar letaltelan:

Hakkash sheal hammitta lo yenaneennu beyado aval menaneo begufo. veim hu maachal behema muttar letaltelo. vechen im haya alav kar o sadin vechayyotze bahen menaneo beyado shehare naasa kemi sheyyashav alav mibbeod yom. hammachnis kuppa shel afar beveto im yiched lah keren zavit meerev shabbat metaltelo beshabbat veose bo kol tzerachav:

Asur levattel keli mehechano mippene shehu kesoter. ketzad. lo yitten keli tachat hanner beshabbat lekabbel et hashshemen hannotef. shehashshemen shebbanner asur letaltelo uchesheyyippol lakkeli yeaser tiltul hakkeli shehaya muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach en notnin keli tachat hattarnegolet lekabbel betzatah. aval kofe hu hakkeli aleha. vechen kofe hakkeli al kol davar sheasur letaltelo shehare lo bittelo sheim yachpotz yittelennu:

Notnin keli tachat haddelef veim nitmalle hakkeli shofech veshone veeno nimna. vehu sheyyihye haddelef rauy lirchitza aval im eno rauy en notnin veim natan muttar letaltelo bammayim hammeusin shebbo. sheen osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla:

Chavit shel tevel shennishbera mevi keli umanniach tachteha hoil veim avar vetikkeno metukkan hare hu kimtukkan. venotnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot mippene sheen bahen mammash umuttar letaltel hakkeli. kora shennishbera en somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta ella im ken hayu revachim vechol zeman sheyyachpotz yitlem kede shello yevattel keli mehechano. porsin machtzelet al gabbe avanim beshabbat o al gabbe kavveret devorim bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud shehare notlah bechol et sheyyirtze. vechofin et hassal beshabbat lifne haefrochim bishvil sheyyaalu alav veyerdu shehare muttar letaltelo kesheyyerdu mealav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Behema shennafla levor o leammat hammayim im yachol litten lah parnasa bimkomah mefarnesin otah ad motzae shabbat veim lav mevi karim uchesatot umanniach tachteha veim alta alta. veaf al pi shemmevattel keli mehechano shehare mashlicho labbor letoch hammayim mippene tzaar baale chayyim lo gazru. veasur lehaalotah beyado. vechen en okrin behema vechayya veof bechatzer aval dochin otan ad sheyyikkansu. umedaddin agalim useyachim. tarnegolet shebbarcha en medaddin otan mippene shehi nishmetet min hayyad venimtzeu agappeha nitlashin aval dochin otah ad shettikkanes:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 26:
Kol kele haoreg vachavalav vekanim shello muttar letaltelan kichli shemmelachto leissur chutz mikkoved haelyon vechoved hattachton lefi sheen nittalin mippene shehen tekuin. vechen haammudim shel oreg asur letaltelan shemma yetakken haggummot shellahen. ushear kele haoreg muttarin: 
Michbadot shel temara vechayyotze bahen shemmechabbedin bahen et hakkarka hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter shehare muttar lechabbed beshabbat. levenim shennisharu min habbinyan hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter mippene sheruyin lehasev alehen shehare shafin otan umetakkenin otan. veim tzavar otan hare hiktzam veasur letaltelam: 
Cheres ketanna muttar letaltelah afillu birshut harabbim hoil ureuya hi bechatzer lechassot bah pi keli katan. megufat chavit shennitkatta hi ushevareha muttar letaltelah veim zerakah laashpa mibbeod yom asur letaltelah. keli shennitroea lo yitlosh mimmennu cheres lechassot bo o lismoch bo: 
Muttar lehachenis levet hakkisse shalosh avanim mekurzalot lekanneach bahen vechamma shiuran kimlo hayyad. aval adama shehi kerova lehitparech asur letaltelah lekanneach bah. umuttar lehaalot avanim laggag lekanneach bahen. yardu alehen geshamim venishtaku betit im rishshuman nikkar muttar letaltel. even sheyyesh aleha tinnuf shevvadday lekanneach hi muttar letaltelah vaafillu hi gedola: 
Haya lefanav tzeror vecheres mekanneach batztzeror veim haya hacheres meogne kelim mekanneach bacheres. hayu lefanav tzeror vaasavim im hayu asavim rakkim mekanneach bahen veim lav mekanneach batztzeror: 
Sheyare machtzelaot shebbalu hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter mippene sheruyin lechassot bahen hattinnuf. aval sheyare begadim shebbalu sheen bahen shelosha al shelosha asur letaltelan sheenan reuyin lo laaniyyim velo laashirim. shivre hattannur muttar letaltelan vahare hen kechol hakkelim shemmelachtan lehetter. kira shennishmeta achat miyyarchoteha asur letaltelah shemma yitka: 
Sullam shel aliyya asur letaltelo sheen alav torat keli. veshel shovach muttar lehattoto. aval lo yolicho mishshovach leshovach shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo latzud. kane shemmoskin bo hazzetim im yesh alav torat keli hare hu kichli shemmelachto leissur. kane shehitkino baal habbayit lihyot poteach venoel bo im yesh torat keli alav hare hu kichli shemmelachto lehetter: 
Delet shehaya lah tzir af al pi sheen lah atta tzir shehechinah listom bah makom muktze vehi nigreret shennotlin otah vesotmin bah. vechen chadakim shessotmin bahen happirtza. vechen machtzelet hannigreret. bizman shekkeshurin uteluyin bakkotel sotmin bahen venoalim bahem veim lav en noalin bahen. veim hayu gevohim meal haaretz noalin bahen: 
Delet shehaya lah luach echad sheshshomtin otah venoalin bah im lo haya lah lematta ken kemo askuppa shemmochiach aleha shehi keli muchan linila en noalin bah. veim yesh lematta askuppa noalim bah. vechen neger sheyyesh berosho kelustera shemmochachat alav shehu keli muchan linila veeno kora kishar kol hakkorot noalin bo beshabbat: 
Neger sheen berosho kelustera im haya kashur vetaluy baddelet noalin bo. vechen im haya nittal veegdo immo. aval im haya egdo kavua baddelet vehaya hanneger nishmat kemo kora umannichin oto bazzavit vechozrin venoalin bo beet sherotzin hare ze asur linol bo sheen alav torat keli veeno agud veen bo eged lehochiach alav: 
Menora shel chulyot ben gedola ben ketanna en metaltelin otah shemma yachazirenah beshabbat. hayu bah chadakim vehi niret kevaalat chulyot. im hayta gedola hannittelet bishte yadayim asur letaltelah mippene kavdah. hayta ketanna mizzo muttar letaltelah: 
Minal sheal gabbe haimmum shomtin oto beshabbat. machbesh shel baale battim mattirin aval lo kovshin. veshel kovsin lo yigga bo mippene shehu muktze mechamat chesron kis. vechen gizze tzemer en metaltelin otan mippene shehu makpid alehen. lefichach im yichadan letashmish muttarin. vehashshelachin muttar letaltelan ben shehayu shel baal habbayit o shel umman mippene sheeno makpid alehem: 
Kol davar metunnaf kegon rei veki vetzoa vechayyotze bahen im hayu bechatzer sheyyoshvin bah muttar lehotzian leashpa o levet hakkisse veze hu hannikra geraf shel rei. veim hayu bechatzer acheret kofin alehen keli kede shello yetze hakkatan veyitlachlech bahen. rok sheal hakkarka dorso lefi tummo veholech. metaltelin kenuna mippene efro af al pi sheyyesh alav shivre etzim mippene shehu kigraf shel rei. veen osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla beshabbat. aval im naasa meelav o sheavar veasahu motziin oto: 
Shemen sheyyotze mittachat hakkora shel bet habbad beshabbat vechen temarim ushekedim hammuchanim lischora muttar leachlam beshabbat. vaafillu otzar shel tevua o tevua tzevura matchil lehistappek mimmenna beshabbat sheen shum ochel shehu muktze beshabbat kelal ella hakkol muchan hu. chutz miggerogarot vetzimmukin shebbammuktze bizman shemmeyabbeshim otam hoil umasrichot bentayim veenam reuyin laachila hare hen asurin beshabbat mishshum muktze. chavit shennitgalleta vaavattiach shennishbera af al pi sheenan reuyin laachila notlan umannichan bemakom hammutzna. kayyotze bo kamea sheeno mumche af al pi sheen yotzin bo metaltelin oto. motar hashshemen shebbanner veshebbakkeara shehidliku bahen beotah shabbat asur lehistappek mimmennu beotah shabbat mippene shehu muktze mechamat issur: 
Otzar shel tevua o shel kadde yayin af al pi shemmuttar lehistappek mimmennu asur lehatechil bo lefannoto ella lidvar mitzva kegon sheppinnahu lehachenasat orchin o likboa bo bet hammidrash vechetzad mefannin oto. kol echad veechad memalle arba o chamesh kuppot ad sheggomrin. velo yechabbedu karkaito shel otzar kemo shebbearnu ella nichnas veyotze bo veose shevil beraglav bichnisato uvitziato: 
Kol shehu rauy lemaachal behema vechayya veof hammetzuyin metaltelin oto beshabbat. ketzad. metaltelin et hatturmos hayyavesh mippene shehu maachol leizzim aval lo et hallach. et hechatzav mippene shehu maachol litzvaim. et hachardal mippene shehu maachol leyonim. et haatzamot mippene shehen maachol lichlavim. vechen kol hakkelippin vehaggarinin haruyin lemaachal behema metaltelin otan. vesheenan reuyin ochel et haochel vezorkan leacharav veasur letaltelan. metaltelin basar tafuach mippene shehu maachol lechayya. umetaltelin basar chay ben tafel ben maliach mippene sherauy leadam. vechen dag maliach. aval hattafel asur letaltelo: 
En metaltelin shivre zechuchit af al pi shehen maachol lenaamiyyot. velo chavile zemorot af al pi shehen maachol lefilim. velo et halluf af al pi shehen maachol leorvim. mippene sheen ellu vechayyotze bahen metzuyin etzel rov bene adam: 
Chavile kash vachavile zeradin im hitkinan lemaachal behema metaltelin otan veim lav en metaltelin otan. chavile sea pua veezov vekoranit. hichnisan leetzim en mistappek mehem beshabbat. lemaachal behema mistappek mehen. vechen baaminta vechen befegam vechen bishar mine tavlin: 
En gorfin maachol millifne happetam ben beevus shel keli ben beevus shel karka. veen mesallekin latztzedadin mippene hari gezera shemma yashve gummot. notlin millifne hachamor venotnin lifne hashshor. aval en notlin millifne hashshor venotnin lifne hachamor mippene shehammaachol shellifne hashshor metunnaf beriro veen rauy lemaachal behema acheret. vechen alim sherecham ra umeusin veen habbehema ochaltan asur letaltelan. lefichach telay shel dagim asur letaltelo veshel basar muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Af al pi sheasur letaltel et hammet beshabbat sachin oto umedichin oto uvilvad shello yazizu bo evar. veshomtin et hakkar mittachtav kede sheyyihye muttal al hachol bishvil sheyyamtin velo yasriach. umeviin kele meker uchele mattachot umannichin lo al kereso kede shello yitpach. ufokkin et nekavav shello yikkanes bahen haruach. vekoshrin et hallechi lo sheyyaale ella shello yosif. veen meammetzin et enav beshabbat: 
Met hammuttal bachamma manniach alav kikkar o tinok umetaltelo. vechen im nafla deleka bechatzer sheyyesh bah met manniach alav kikkar o tinok umetaltelo. veim en sham kikkar velo tinok matztzilin oto min haddeleka mikkol makom shemma yavo lechabbot mippene shehu bahul al meto shello yissaref. velo hittiru letaltel bechikkar o tinok ella lemet bilvad mippene sheadam bahul al meto: 
Haya muttal bachamma veen lahem makom letaltelo o shello ratzu lahazizo mimmekomo bain shene bene adam veyoshvim mishshene tzedadav. cham lahem millematta ze mevi mittato veyoshev aleha veze mevi mittato veyoshev aleha. cham lahem millemala ze mevi machtzelet uforesh al gabbav. veze mevi machtzelet uforesh al gabbav. ze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo veze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo venimtza mechitztza asuya meeleha. shehare machtzelet ze umachtzelet ze gaggehen semuchot zo lazo ushene ketzotehem al hakkarka mishni tzidde hammet: 
Met shehisriach bevayit venimtza mitbazze ben hachayyim vehem mitbazzim mimmennu muttar lehotzio lecharmelit. gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora shehu <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "lo tasur min haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usemol". veim haya lahen makom acher latzet bo en motziin oto ella menichin oto bimkomo veyotzin hem:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 27: Hayyotze chutz litchum hammedina beshabbat loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 16 29)</small> "al yetze ish mimmekomo bayyom hashshevii". makom ze hu techum hair. velo natna tora shiur litchum ze aval chachamim hetiku shettechum ze hu chutz lishnem asar mil keneged machane yisrael. vechach amar lahem moshe rabbenu lo tetzu chutz lammachane. umiddivre sofrim shello yetze adam chutz lair ella ad alpayim amma aval chutz lealpayim amma asur. shealpayim amma hu migrash hair:

Nimtzeta lamed shemmuttar leadam beshabbat lehallech et kol hair kullah afillu hayta keninve. ben shehayta mukkefet choma ben shello hayta mukkefet choma. vechen muttar lo lehallech chutz lair alpayim amma lechol ruach merubbaot ketavla merubbaat kede sheyyihye niskar et hazzaviyyot. veim yatza chutz lealpayim amma makkin oto makkat mardut ad shenem asar mil. aval im yatza vehirchik min hair yeter al shenem asar mil afillu amma achat loke min hattora:
